title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
title_zh: PhysLDM：用于高保真可变形模拟的潜在扩散模型

paragraphs.en: Neural simulation of high-fidelity deformable bodies is a foundational challenge in computer graphics and physical AI. Long-horizon prediction for high-resolution 3D volumetric meshes is difficult: autoregressive methods are susceptible to error accumulation, while direct multi-frame prediction at native resolution is computationally prohibitive. This motivates a compact spatiotemporal latent representation, which remains largely unexplored for mesh-based volumetric physics. Meanwhile, it remains unclear whether deterministic regression or generative diffusion is the more appropriate predictive paradigm. To address these coupled challenges, we introduce PhysLDM, a unified latent-diffusion paradigm for one-shot volumetric deformable simulation. Its core is a holistic spatiotemporal VAE (ST-VAE) that avoids the “staircase” artifacts of standard temporal compression (as in common video VAEs) and disentangles rigid motion from local deformation, achieving ∼ \sim 2.48 mm reconstruction precision on meter-scale scenes at up to 78 × \times token compression. Based on this reliable latent space, we systematically compare regression and diffusion paradigms. Our experiments uncover a key modeling insight: complex deformable dynamics are often chaotic, and in this regime deterministic regression tends to produce damped, non-physical averages, whereas diffusion better models their distribution. Accordingly, we employ a latent diffusion model that effectively learns from the chaotic data to generate physically plausible trajectories. Trained purely kinematically on an Objaverse-scale simulation dataset, a single PhysLDM generalizes zero-shot to unseen OOD object datasets (GSO and Toys4K). Its differentiability further enables efficient solution of inverse problems and higher-order design optimization. To our knowledge, PhysLDM is the first high-fidelity spatiotemporal autoencoder and latent-diffusion paradigm for volumetric deformable dynamics, offering a scalable and robust approach to neural simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 高保真可变形物体的神经模拟是计算机图形学和物理人工智能领域的一项基础挑战。 对高分辨率三维体网格进行长期预测十分困难：自回归方法容易积累误差，而以原始分辨率直接进行多帧预测则计算成本过高。 这促使人们探索一种紧凑的时空潜在表示，但它在基于网格的体物理模拟中仍基本未被开发。 同时，目前尚不清楚确定性回归与生成式扩散中哪一种预测范式更为适用。 为应对这些相互关联的挑战，我们提出了 PhysLDM——一种用于单次体可变形模拟的统一潜在扩散范式。 其核心是一个全息的时空 VAE（ST-VAE），能够避免传统时间压缩方法（如常见视频 VAE）产生的“阶梯状”伪影，并将刚体运动与局部形变分离开来，在米级场景中实现了高达 78 × 标记压缩率下约 2.48 毫米的重建精度。 基于这一可靠的潜在空间，我们系统性地比较了回归与扩散两种范式。 我们的实验揭示了一个关键的建模洞见：复杂的可变形动态往往具有混沌性，在此情况下，确定性回归倾向于产生被抑制的非物理平均值，而扩散模型则能更好地模拟其分布。 因此，我们采用了一种潜在扩散模型，使其能够有效地从混沌数据中学习，从而生成物理上合理的轨迹。 该模型完全基于 Objaverse 规模的模拟数据集进行运动学训练，单个 PhysLDM 即可零样本泛化到未见过的 OOD 对象数据集（GSO 和 Toys4K）。 其可微分性进一步支持了对逆问题的高效求解以及更高阶的设计优化。 据我们所知，PhysLDM 是首个用于体可变形动态的高保真时空自编码器和潜在扩散范式，为神经模拟提供了一种可扩展且稳健的方法。

paragraphs.en: Simulating the dynamics of deformable solids is essential to fields involving physical interaction, including computer graphics, engineering, and robotics. Furthermore, learning these complex dynamics as predictive physical world models is also considered essential for physical AI. However, fulfilling this vision with traditional simulators remains a fundamental bottleneck: classical high-precision solvers are accurate but slow, and their gradients are hard to obtain. Neural simulation is an emerging alternative: its goal is to learn these complex physical behaviors directly from data, offering fast, differentiable surrogates that bypass the computational bottlenecks of classical solvers ( Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ; Pfaff et al., 2021 ) . Nevertheless, high-fidelity deformable simulation demands a high-resolution geometric representation, typically a volumetric mesh with thousands to tens of thousands of vertices. Efficiently and accurately predicting the long-horizon trajectories of such large-scale systems poses significant challenges for conventional neural architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟可变形固体的动态过程对于涉及物理交互的领域至关重要，包括计算机图形学、工程学和机器人学。 此外，将这些复杂的动态过程学习为预测性物理世界模型，也被认为是实现物理人工智能的关键。 然而，使用传统模拟器来实现这一愿景仍存在根本性瓶颈：经典的高精度求解器虽然准确，但运行缓慢，且其梯度难以获取。 神经模拟是一种新兴的替代方案：其目标是从数据中直接学习这些复杂的物理行为，从而提供快速且可微分的代理模型，绕过经典求解器的计算瓶颈（Sanchez-Gonzalez 等人，2020；Pfaff 等人，2021）。 尽管如此，高保真的可变形模拟需要高分辨率的几何表示，通常是包含数千至数万顶点的体网格。 高效且准确地预测此类大规模系统的长期轨迹，对传统神经架构而言构成了重大挑战。

paragraphs.en: Achieving this, however, presents several tightly coupled challenges. First, high-fidelity 3D volumetric meshes contain large, object-dependent numbers of vertices, resulting in extremely high-dimensional system states. Existing autoregressive (AR) approaches predict the dynamics frame by frame, without jointly modeling the full temporal horizon, and are therefore susceptible to compounding errors and trajectory drift over long rollouts. One-shot prediction of the entire trajectory provides global temporal context, but operating directly at native resolution is computationally prohibitive. Consequently, compressing these complex dynamics into a spatiotemporal latent space becomes necessary, yet largely unexplored for mesh-based volumetric physics. This introduces the first challenge: a representational bottleneck. In our explorations, we find that standard compression methods ( e.g. , with uniform temporal strides and local temporal upsamplers, as in standard video-VAE designs ( Yu et al., 2023 ) ) lose high-frequency temporal information and make reconstructed shapes jump unnaturally, producing a “staircase” artifact that we analyze in Sec. 4 (Staircase analysis). Furthermore, directly compressing raw world coordinates forces models to entangle large-scale rigid motion with millimeter-scale local deformations, severely degrading precision.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，要实现这一点，会面临几个紧密耦合的挑战。 首先，高保真度的三维体网格包含大量依赖于具体物体的顶点，导致系统状态维度极高。 现有的自回归（AR）方法逐帧预测动态变化，而未对完整的时间范围进行联合建模，因此在长时间推演中容易累积误差并出现轨迹漂移。 一次性预测整个轨迹可提供全局时间上下文，但直接在原始分辨率下操作会带来巨大的计算负担。 因此，将这些复杂的动态压缩到时空潜在空间中成为必要，但对于基于网格的体物理模拟而言，这一领域尚未被充分探索。 这就引出了第一个挑战：表示能力的瓶颈。 在我们的探索中我们发现，标准的压缩方法（例如，采用均匀时间步长和局部时间上采样器的方法，如标准视频VAE设计（Yu et al., 2023））会丢失高频时间信息，导致重建的形状出现不自然的跳跃，产生一种“阶梯状”的伪影，我们将在第4节（阶梯分析）中对此进行分析。 此外，直接压缩原始世界坐标会迫使模型将大规模刚性运动与毫米级的局部形变纠缠在一起，从而严重降低精度。

sents.zh: 然而，要实现这一点，会面临几个紧密耦合的挑战。

paragraphs.en: The second challenge is the optimal predictive paradigm: it remains an open question whether deterministic regression or generative diffusion is better suited for complex physical simulation, and a systematic comparison in the context of 3D volumetric physics is currently absent. Our systematic experiments reveal a critical insight: microscopic non-determinism can be strongly amplified by the inherently chaotic nature of complex deformable dynamics. For instance, state-of-the-art GPU-based physical solvers ( Huang et al., 2024a ; Huang et al., 2025 ) exhibit only slight microscopic non-determinism, yet chaos can amplify this small difference into vastly different final trajectories (Sec. 4 , Chaos analysis). In this chaotic regime, nearly identical initial conditions can correspond to multiple macroscopically different yet physically plausible futures. Deterministic regression tends to average over these modes, producing damped trajectories that may match none of them, whereas generative diffusion can represent and sample from the multi-modal distribution of plausible outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个挑战是最优预测范式：确定性回归与生成式扩散方法中，哪种更适合复杂的物理模拟，目前仍是一个悬而未决的问题，而且目前尚缺乏在三维体物理语境下的系统性比较。 我们的系统性实验揭示了一个关键洞见：微观的非确定性可能因复杂可变形动力学的内在混沌特性而被显著放大。 例如，当前最先进的基于 GPU 的物理求解器（Huang et al., 2024a；Huang et al., 2025）仅表现出轻微的微观非确定性，但混沌效应却能将这种微小差异放大为截然不同的最终轨迹（第 4 节，混沌分析）。 在这种混沌状态下，几乎相同的初始条件可能对应多种在宏观上截然不同但物理上合理的未来状态。 确定性回归倾向于对这些模式进行平均，从而产生被抑制的轨迹，这些轨迹可能与任何单一模式都不匹配；而生成式扩散则能够表示并从合理结果的多元分布中进行采样。

paragraphs.en: To overcome these tightly coupled representational and predictive limitations, we propose PhysLDM, a latent-diffusion paradigm for one-shot volumetric deformable simulation. The foundation of PhysLDM is a novel holistic spatiotemporal variational autoencoder (ST-VAE) specifically designed for mesh-based volumetric physics. By employing a holistic temporal compression strategy and explicitly decoupling rigid body motion from local deformation, our ST-VAE eliminates “staircase” artifacts and preserves fine geometric details. This design achieves a ∼ \sim 2.48 mm average geometric reconstruction precision for meter-scale scenes at up to a 78 × 78\times token compression. By employing a Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , PhysLDM models the distribution of physically plausible future trajectories, whereas deterministic regression produces damped averages in our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 为了克服这些紧密耦合的表示和预测方面的局限性，我们提出了 PhysLDM——一种用于单样本体积可变形模拟的潜在扩散范式。 PhysLDM 的基础是一种新颖的整体时空变分自编码器（ST-VAE），专为基于网格的体积物理而设计。 通过采用整体时间压缩策略，并明确将刚体运动与局部形变解耦，我们的 ST-VAE 消除了“阶梯状”伪影，同时保留了精细的几何细节。 这种设计在最大 78 × 78\times 的标记压缩率下，对米级场景实现了约 \sim 2.48 mm 的平均几何重建精度。 通过采用潜在扩散模型（LDM）（Rombach 等人，2022），PhysLDM 能够建模物理上合理的未来轨迹分布，而确定性回归在我们的实验中则产生了衰减的平均值。

sents.zh: 通过采用潜在扩散模型（LDM）（Rombach 等人，2022），PhysLDM 能够建模物理上合理的未来轨迹分布，而确定性回归在我们的实验中则产生了衰减的平均值。

paragraphs.en: A prominent feature of our paradigm is its constitutive-model-agnostic nature. Supervised purely kinematically on an Objaverse-scale dataset, a single PhysLDM demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization capabilities to unseen, out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. We further demonstrate the utility of PhysLDM as a differentiable simulator for inverse problems and design optimization. To our knowledge, PhysLDM yields the first high-fidelity spatiotemporal autoencoder and latent-diffusion paradigm for volumetric deformable dynamics, offering a scalable and robust approach to neural simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们这一范式的显著特征在于其对本体模型无关的特性。 通过在 Objaverse 规模的数据集上仅基于运动学进行监督训练，单个 PhysLDM 展现出对未见过的分布外（OOD）数据集的强大零样本泛化能力。 我们还进一步证明了 PhysLDM 作为可微分模拟器在逆问题与设计优化中的实用性。 据我们所知，PhysLDM 首次实现了用于体积可变形动力学的保真度高的时空自编码器和潜在扩散范式，为神经模拟提供了一种可扩展且稳健的方法。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our main contributions include:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的主要贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: A high-fidelity ST-VAE for 3D volumetric deformable dynamics. We propose a novel holistic temporal compression scheme for volumetric mesh deformable dynamics, which removes the “staircase” artifacts that persist under standard temporal compression. By explicitly decoupling rigid motion and deformation, we achieve ∼ \sim 2.48mm average geometric reconstruction precision for meter-scale scenes with up to 78 × \times token compression.
paragraphs.zh: 一种用于三维体变形动力学的高保真 ST-VAE。 我们提出了一种全新的整体时间压缩方案，用于处理体网格变形动力学，该方案能够消除标准时间压缩下持续存在的“阶梯状”伪影。 通过明确分离刚体运动和形变，我们在最大可达 78 × \times 的标记压缩率下，实现了米级场景约 ∼ \sim 2.48mm 的平均几何重建精度。

sents.en: A high-fidelity ST-VAE for 3D volumetric deformable dynamics.
sents.zh: 一种用于三维体变形动力学的高保真 ST-VAE。

paragraphs.en: A systematic comparison of deterministic regression and generative diffusion paradigms in physical simulation. We reveal that the inherently chaotic nature of complex deformable dynamics can amplify the non-determinism that GPU solvers exhibit under identical initial conditions, and show that in this chaotic regime diffusion is better suited than deterministic regression, whose outputs collapse toward damped averages.
paragraphs.zh: 对物理模拟中确定性回归与生成式扩散范式进行系统性比较。 我们发现，复杂可变形动力学固有的混沌特性会放大 GPU 求解器在相同初始条件下表现出的非确定性，并表明在这种混沌状态下，扩散方法比确定性回归更为适用，因为确定性回归的输出会坍缩为衰减的平均值。

paragraphs.en: A constitutive-model-agnostic latent diffusion paradigm with strong zero-shot generalization. We present a latent-diffusion paradigm and train a single model, PhysLDM, on Objaverse-scale simulations ( Deitke et al., 2023 ) supervised purely kinematically. Our model transfers zero-shot to unseen OOD object datasets (GSO ( Downs et al., 2022 ) , Toys4K ( Stojanov et al., 2021 ) ) with remarkable robustness.

PhysLDM supports end-to-end and higher-order differentiation, enabling efficient material estimation and second-order design optimization tasks that are difficult or computationally prohibitive for existing differentiable simulators.

paragraphs.en: Physics-based deformable simulation. Physics-based Lagrangian simulation has a rich history in computer graphics, evolving from early elastic models ( Terzopoulos et al., 1987 ) to finite element methods (FEM) ( Irving et al., 2004 ) , contact handling ( Bridson et al., 2002 ) , and others ( Müller et al., 2007 ; Bouaziz et al., 2014 ) . Recently, barrier-based methods such as incremental potential contact (IPC) provide strict intersection-free guarantees, but incur high computational costs ( Li et al., 2020 ; Huang et al., 2024a ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Ando, 2024 ) . Conversely, real-time solvers achieve interactive rates at the expense of physical fidelity, and they cannot learn the behavior of high-accuracy solvers ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Giles et al., 2025 ) . Differentiable simulators restore gradients, but either require tedious hand-derived formulations or need to backpropagate through every integration step ( Huang et al., 2024b ; The Newton Contributors, 2025 ) . In contrast, PhysLDM serves as a fast, end-to-end differentiable neural surrogate learned directly from high-accuracy solvers.
paragraphs.zh: 基于物理的形变模拟。 基于物理的拉格朗日模拟在计算机图形学领域拥有悠久的历史，从早期的弹性模型（Terzopoulos 等人，1987）发展至有限元法（FEM）（Irving 等人，2004）、接触处理（Bridson 等人，2002）以及其他方法（Müller 等人，2007；Bouaziz 等人，2014）。 近期，基于势垒的方法（如增量势接触法，IPC）能够提供严格的无交点保证，但会引发高昂的计算成本（Li 等人，2020；Huang 等人，2024a；Huang 等人，2025；Tang 等人，2026；Ando，2024）。 相反，实时求解器虽然能达到交互帧率，但牺牲了物理保真度，且无法学习高精度求解器的行为（Chen 等人，2024；Giles 等人，2025）。 可微分模拟器能够恢复梯度，但要么需要繁琐的手工推导公式，要么需要在每个积分步骤上进行反向传播（Huang 等人，2024b；The Newton Contributors，2025）。 相比之下，PhysLDM 是一种快速、端到端且可微分的神经代理模型，可直接从高精度求解器中学习得到。

paragraphs.en: Neural simulators for deformable dynamics. Neural simulators provide a fast, fully differentiable alternative to traditional solvers. The dominant paradigm of neural simulators is the AR rollout, which predicts the next state frame-by-frame. This paradigm has been adopted across diverse physical simulation fields ( Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ; Ummenhofer et al., 2020 ; Pfaff et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . However, AR methods lack the global temporal context necessary for long-horizon consistency, potentially leading to temporal incoherence or trajectory drift. The concurrent work of Chen et al. (2026) performs one-shot multi-frame prediction, but is restricted to low-resolution surface meshes (training on about 356 356 vertices per scene) from a limited set of templates ( 35 35 different meshes). In contrast, PhysLDM introduces a latent-diffusion paradigm capable of predicting high-resolution volumetric trajectories in a single diffusion pass, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization to diverse OOD scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 用于可变形动力学的神经模拟器。 神经模拟器为传统求解器提供了一种快速且完全可微分的替代方案。 神经模拟器的主流范式是 AR 展开，即逐帧预测下一状态。 这一范式已被广泛应用于各种物理模拟领域（Sanchez-Gonzalez 等人，2020；Ummenhofer 等人，2020；Pfaff 等人，2021；Zhang 等人，2026；Wang 等人，2026）。 然而，AR 方法缺乏长期一致性所需的全局时间上下文，可能导致时间不连贯或轨迹漂移。 Chen 等人的并行研究 （2026）实现了单次多帧预测，但仅限于低分辨率表面网格（每场景训练约 356×356 个顶点），且局限于有限的模板集（35×35 种不同网格）。 相比之下，PhysLDM 引入了一种潜在扩散范式，能够在单次扩散过程中预测高分辨率体积轨迹，并展现出对多样化 OOD 场景的强零样本泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Spatiotemporal latent representations. High-fidelity volumetric simulation involves high-resolution meshes, making direct multi-frame prediction computationally prohibitive at native resolutions. However, spatiotemporal autoencoders remain largely unexplored for high-fidelity, volumetric-mesh deformable-body physical simulation. In fact, existing autoencoders for physical simulation typically compress only the spatial domain ( Barbic and James, 2005 ; Fulton et al., 2019 ; Romero et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Chang et al., 2023 ; Modi et al., 2024 ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Wiewel et al., 2019 ; Han et al., 2022 ) , with concurrent neural simulators following a similar pattern ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Geng et al., 2026 ) . While spatiotemporal autoencoders have been successfully deployed in other domains, their architectures are tailored to their respective tasks, such as video generation ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) and other fields ( Petrovich et al., 2021 ; Cao et al., 2024 ) . Unfortunately, these designs do not transfer directly to deformable physics. For example, transplanting the standard temporal compression of video VAEs produces severe staircase artifacts (as analyzed in Sec. 4 , Staircase analysis). To our knowledge, our ST-VAE is the first spatiotemporal autoencoder designed specifically for high-fidelity deformable simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 时空潜在表示。 高保真体素模拟涉及高分辨率网格，这使得以原始分辨率进行直接多帧预测的计算成本极高。 然而，对于高保真、基于体素网格的可变形物体物理模拟而言，时空自编码器在很大程度上仍未被探索。 事实上，现有的物理模拟自编码器通常仅对空间域进行压缩（Barbic and James, 2005；Fulton et al., 2019；Romero et al., 2021；Chen et al., 2023；Chang et al., 2023；Modi et al., 2024；Liao et al., 2026；Wiewel et al., 2019；Han et al., 2022），而同步运行的神经模拟器也遵循类似模式（Zhang et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026；Geng et al., 2026）。 尽管时空自编码器已成功应用于其他领域，但其架构均针对各自任务进行了专门设计，例如视频生成（Yu et al., 2023；Yang et al., 2025）及其他领域（Petrovich et al., 2021；Cao et al., 2024）。 遗憾的是，这些设计无法直接迁移到可变形物理模拟中。 例如，若将标准视频 VAE 的时间域压缩方法直接移植过来，会产生严重的阶梯状伪影（如第 4 节“阶梯分析”中所分析的）。 据我们所知，我们的 ST-VAE 是首个专为高保真可变形模拟设计的时空自编码器。

paragraphs.en: Prediction paradigms: regression versus diffusion. For deformable-body physical simulation, deterministic regression and generative diffusion have never been systematically compared. In practice, most work in neural simulation uses regression ( Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ; Pfaff et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Dou et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Meanwhile, diffusion ( Ho et al., 2020 ) has instead been adopted where output distributions matter, such as image and video synthesis ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ho et al., 2022 ) and human motion ( Tevet et al., 2023 ) . Although the concurrent work of Chen et al. (2026) claims that diffusion is superior to deterministic regression, motivated by the diversity of futures under unobserved initial conditions, it never compares one-shot regression with diffusion. By contrast, we systematically compare both paradigms and find that under the chaotic dynamics of complex deformable bodies diffusion is more suitable, and regression may collapse onto non-physical averages.
paragraphs.zh: 预测范式：回归与扩散。对于可变形体的物理模拟，确定性回归与生成式扩散从未被系统性地比较过。在实践中，大多数神经模拟研究都使用了回归方法（Sanchez-Gonzalez 等人，2020；Pfaff 等人，2021；Zhang 等人，2026；Dou 等人，2026；Wang 等人，2026）。与此同时，当输出分布至关重要时，例如图像和视频合成（Rombach 等人，2022；Ho 等人，2022）以及人类运动（Tevet 等人，2023），则更倾向于采用扩散方法。尽管 Chen 等人（2026）的同步研究声称，由于未观测初始条件下未来状态的多样性，扩散优于确定性回归，但该研究从未将单次回归与扩散进行比较。相比之下，我们对这两种范式进行了系统性比较，并发现：在复杂可变形体的混沌动力学行为下，扩散方法更为适用，而回归方法可能会坍缩为非物理的平均状态。

paragraphs.en: where 𝐑 t ∈ SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathbf{R}_{t}\in\mathrm{SO}(3) and 𝐜 t ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{c}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} denote the per-frame rigid rotation and centroid translation, and 𝐝 t \mathbf{d}_{t} represents the residual canonical (rigid-free) deformation field. paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2 , PhysLDM has three main modules: a Spatial VAE, an ST-VAE, and an LDM.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 所示，PhysLDM 包含三个主要模块：一个空间 VAE、一个 ST-VAE 和一个 LDM。

paragraphs.en: Spatial VAE. To efficiently process high-resolution volumetric meshes of varying vertex counts, we compress individual frames using a Spatial VAE. Following the representation of Zhang et al. (2026) , a set of K K learnable query tokens cross-attends the canonical mesh vertices to extract a fixed-size set of K K latent tokens 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t} , which remains independent of the vertex count N N . The decoder mirrors the encoder: each rest vertex, embedded with its position, cross-attends the latent tokens and is decoded to its displacement. This module ensures that the latent representation is resolution-independent.
paragraphs.zh: 空间 VAE。为了高效处理顶点数量各异的高分辨率体网格，我们使用空间 VAE 对单帧数据进行压缩。遵循 Zhang 等人（2026）的表示方法，一组 K 个可学习的查询标记通过交叉注意力机制与标准网格的顶点进行交互，从而提取出一组固定大小的 K 个潜在标记 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t}，该标记集与顶点数量 N N 无关。解码器的结构与编码器对称：每个静止顶点在嵌入其位置信息后，通过交叉注意力机制与潜在标记进行交互，并被解码为其位移。该模块确保了潜在表示与分辨率无关。

paragraphs.en: ST-VAE. The ST-VAE compresses the input T T -frame trajectory by a factor of T / M T/M into a compact latent 𝐙 \mathbf{Z} . Each frame is represented by K + 1 K{+}1 tokens: the K K deformation tokens from the spatial VAE and one additional rigid token that embeds the pose ( 𝐑 t \mathbf{R}_{t} and 𝐜 t \mathbf{c}_{t} ) in its channels. This token sequence first passes through axial blocks that alternate self-attention across tokens within a frame and along the temporal axis ( Ho et al., 2019 ; Bertasius et al., 2021 ; Arnab et al., 2021 ) , after which it is decoupled into a deformation track and a rigid track. For the deformation track, the standard choice (as in video VAEs) would merge every T / M T/M frames into one latent frame and then decode it with a local temporal upsampler. However, this standard design introduces the staircase artifacts analyzed in Sec. 4 (Staircase analysis). We instead employ a holistic temporal representation where time is summarized by factorized self-attention: for each of the K K spatial tokens separately, M M learnable queries are prepended to its temporal sequence, attended along the time axis, and kept as the only temporal outputs, giving K × M K\times M tokens in total, which we call holistic temporal tokens. For the rigid track, sharing the holistic tokens with the deformation causes capacity competition and degrades the reconstruction (see ablation in Sec. 4.1 ). The rigid token therefore takes a dedicated linear temporal pathway and recombines with the canonical shape per frame during decoding. Ultimately, the two tracks merge into the single joint latent 𝐙 \mathbf{Z} that serves as the training target of the LDM. The ST-VAE decoder is kept frozen during the LDM stage to decode latents back into full trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: ST-VAE。 ST-VAE 将输入的 T-T 帧轨迹以 T/M 的压缩率压缩为紧凑的潜在表示 𝐙 \mathbf{Z}。 每一帧由 K+1 个标记表示：来自空间 VAE 的 K 个变形标记，以及一个额外的刚性标记，该标记在其通道中嵌入姿态（𝐑 t \mathbf{R}_{t} 和 𝐜 t \mathbf{c}_{t}）。 该标记序列首先通过轴向块，这些块在帧内标记之间以及沿时间轴上交替进行自注意力处理（Ho et al., 2019; Bertasius et al., 2021; Arnab et al., 2021），之后被解耦为变形轨迹和刚性轨迹。 对于变形轨迹，标准做法（如视频 VAE 中的方法）是将每 T/M 帧合并为一个潜在帧，然后使用局部时间上采样器对其进行解码。 然而，这种标准设计会引入第 4 节中分析的阶梯状伪影（阶梯分析）。 我们转而采用一种整体性时间表示，其中时间通过因子化自注意力进行总结：对于每个空间标记，单独地向其时间序列前缀添加 M 个可学习的查询，沿时间轴进行注意力处理，并仅保留这些作为时间输出，从而得到总共 K×M 个标记，我们称之为整体性时间标记。 对于刚性轨迹，与变形轨迹共享整体性标记会导致容量竞争并降低重建质量（参见第 4.1 节的消融分析）。 因此，刚性标记采用独立的时间线性通路，并在解码时与每帧的标准形状重新组合。 最终，两条轨迹合并为单一的联合潜在表示 𝐙 \mathbf{Z}，该表示作为 LDM 的训练目标。 在 LDM 阶段，ST-VAE 解码器保持冻结状态，用于将潜在表示解码回完整的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: LDM. Conditioned on the initial state, the LDM predicts the latent of the full T T -frame trajectory in one pass. The frame- 0 0 mesh is injected via cross-attention on its spatial latent, while the pose, the initial velocity, and the stiffness condition the network via adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) alongside the flow timestep. The mesh topology enters only through the frozen decoder, whose graph neural network (GNN) refines the decoded vertices over the tetrahedral mesh. We employ a flow-matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) diffusion transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) utilizing rectified flow ( Liu et al., 2023 ) to model the probability path. Architecture details are in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: LDM。 在初始状态的条件约束下，LDM 通过单次处理预测整个 T T 帧轨迹的潜在变量。 第 0 0 帧的网格通过对其空间潜在变量的交叉注意力注入，而姿态、初始速度和刚度则通过自适应层归一化（AdaLN）与流时间步长一同对网络施加条件约束。 网格拓扑仅通过冻结的解码器输入，其图神经网络（GNN）会在四面体网格上对解码后的顶点进行优化。 我们采用一种基于流匹配（Lipman 等，2023）的扩散变换器（DiT）（Peebles 和 Xie，2023），并利用修正流（Liu 等，2023）来建模概率路径。 架构细节见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: Our model is trained in three stages. The first stage trains the spatial VAE with a Charbonnier (smoothed L 1 L_{1} ) position-reconstruction loss and a Kullback–Leibler (KL) loss (see the spatial-VAE-pretraining ablation in Appendix F ). The second stage trains the ST-VAE on top of the pretrained spatial VAE. Its loss consists mainly of deformation and rigid reconstruction losses over all T T frames and a KL loss, together with a latent-anchor loss to the spatial manifold. The third stage trains the LDM on the pretrained, frozen ST-VAE, with a flow-matching velocity mean-squared error (MSE) loss. Complete loss forms, weights, and training details are given in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的模型分三个阶段进行训练。 第一阶段使用 Charbonnier（平滑 L₁ L_{1}）位置重建损失和 Kullback–Leibler（KL）损失来训练空间 VAE（参见附录 F 中的空间 VAE 预训练消融分析）。 第二阶段在预训练好的空间 VAE 基础上进一步训练 ST-VAE。 其损失主要由所有 T 帧的形变和刚性重建损失、一个 KL 损失，以及对空间流形的潜在锚点损失组成。 第三阶段在预训练并冻结的 ST-VAE 上训练 LDM，使用流匹配的速度均方误差（MSE）损失。 完整的损失函数形式、权重和训练细节见附录 A。

sents.en: The third stage trains the LDM on the pretrained, frozen ST-VAE, with a flow-matching velocity mean-squared error (MSE) loss.
sents.zh: 第三阶段在预训练并冻结的 ST-VAE 上训练 LDM，使用流匹配的速度均方误差（MSE）损失。

paragraphs.en: Constitutive-Model-Free Supervision. Notably, our framework relies entirely on kinematic supervision. Every reconstruction loss is computed directly from geometry, namely vertex positions, velocities, and rigid poses. No constitutive models are used during training or inference. This purely data-driven approach makes PhysLDM agnostic to the underlying simulator’s energy model, allowing it to seamlessly scale across diverse materials, and giving it the potential to learn from real-world captured trajectories where explicit energy models are unavailable (Appendix M ).
paragraphs.zh: 构成模型自由监督。 值得注意的是，我们的框架完全依赖运动学监督。 所有重建损失都直接基于几何信息计算得出，即顶点位置、速度和刚性姿态。 在训练或推理过程中均未使用任何构成模型。 这种纯粹以数据驱动的方法使 PhysLDM 对底层模拟器的能量模型保持无关，从而能够无缝地应用于多种材料，并具备从现实世界中采集的轨迹中学习的能力——在这些场景中，显式的能量模型并不可用（附录 M）。

paragraphs.en: We generate high-accuracy physical simulation data with a GPU FEM solver based on IPC ( Huang et al., 2024a ; Huang et al., 2025 ) . For each scene, we randomly select n n objects ( n ≤ 3 n\leq 3 ) from more than 30,000 30{,}000 Objaverse objects, tetrahedralize them with fTetWild ( Hu et al., 2020 ) into volumetric meshes, and assign each object a random initial velocity ( v 0 v_{0} ) and a random stiffness (Young’s modulus, E E ). The simulation time step is 1 / 60 1/60 s and each trajectory has 64 64 frames. The Objaverse scenes ( 63,397 63{,}397 single-object and 16,078 16{,}078 multi-body trajectories) are split into training, validation, and held-out test sets at a ratio of 90 % : 5 % : 5 % 90\%:5\%:5\% . For OOD evaluation, we generate scenes in the same way from the objects of two other datasets, GSO and Toys4K. The ST-VAE and the LDM are trained on scenes with N ∈ [ 500 , 5 , 000 ] N\in[500,5{,}000] vertices. The ST-VAE and LDM results in this paper are trained on single-object scenes ( n = 1 n{=}1 ). Our extended model is trained on multi-object scenes ( n ≤ 3 n\leq 3 ; see the multi-body extension in Appendix J ). In the controlled ST-VAE comparisons, we use ST-VAE Small ( K = 512 K{=}512 , T = 32 T{=}32 , M = 4 M{=}4 , 95 95 M parameters). In the LDM experiments, we use ST-VAE Base ( K = 512 K{=}512 , T = 64 T{=}64 , M = 8 M{=}8 , 124 124 M parameters; Table 3 ). Both configurations compress a trajectory by 8 ​ N / 513 8N/513 in token count, which reaches 78 × 78\times at the 5,000 5{,}000 -vertex cap. Training details are in Appendix A . Full data details, evaluation setup, and metric definitions are in Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: Standard temporal compression methods (such as video VAEs) uniformly compress consecutive frames into fixed latent blocks along the time axis and decode them with a local temporal upsampler, but this approach is not suitable for 3D volumetric deformable dynamics trajectory reconstruction: it causes the object’s deformation to hold and then snap to the next state, creating an unnatural “staircase” artifact that severely degrades visual fidelity. While this timing error is easily perceptible in video playback, it is difficult to identify from static multi-frame snapshots alone; therefore, we quantify it via the deformation-change correlation (DCC), defined in Appendix B.3 . Although DCC does not solely measure overall reconstruction quality on its own, it plays a decisive role in evaluating the physical plausibility of the motion when reconstruction precision is comparable. A detailed analysis of the staircase artifact is given in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 标准的时序压缩方法（例如视频 VAE）会沿着时间轴将连续帧均匀地压缩为固定的潜在块，并通过局部时序上采样器进行解码。但这种方法不适用于三维体变形动态轨迹的重建：它会导致物体的形变保持原状，然后突然跳转到下一个状态，从而产生不自然的“阶梯状”伪影，严重降低视觉保真度。 尽管这种时间错误在视频播放中很容易察觉，但仅凭静态的多帧快照却难以识别；因此，我们通过变形变化相关性（DCC）来量化这一问题，其定义见附录 B.3。 虽然 DCC 本身并不单独衡量整体的重建质量，但在重建精度相当的情况下，它在评估运动物理合理性方面起着决定性作用。 关于阶梯状伪影的详细分析见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: Although physics simulators are commonly assumed to produce deterministic trajectories once initial states and parameters are fully specified, this is not guaranteed for GPU solvers. As shown in Fig. 7 , running the same scene five times from byte-identical inputs yields visibly different final poses, with corresponding vertices landing up to 442 442 mm apart. This divergence stems from two factors: first, the underlying hardware non-determinism of GPU solvers introduces negligible initial variations; second, the inherently chaotic nature of complex deformable dynamics can rapidly amplify these microscopic errors into macroscopic trajectory divergence. Consequently, training data is not a deterministic function of initial conditions. We also verify this at scale on the 300 300 Objaverse held-out scenes: running each scene twice from identical initial conditions, the final-frame vertex trajectories of 23.7 % 23.7\% of these meter-scale scenes differ by more than 1 % 1\% of the object size (about 1 1 cm), and those of 7.7 % 7.7\% differ by more than 5 % 5\% (about 5 5 cm) (Table 5 ). This chaotic nature suggests why regression models struggle: faced with multiple branching futures, a squared-error loss would drive the model toward the conditional mean, collapsing incompatible outcomes into a damped and non-physical average. A generative approach like our LDM naturally avoids this by sampling plausible trajectories. A more detailed chaos analysis is given in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管人们通常认为，一旦初始状态和参数完全确定，物理模拟器就能产生确定性轨迹，但 GPU 求解器却无法保证这一点。 如图 7 所示，对完全相同的字节级输入运行同一场景五次，最终得到的姿态明显不同，对应的顶点位置最大相差可达 442.442 毫米。 这种差异源于两个因素：首先，GPU 求解器底层硬件的非确定性会引入可忽略不计的初始微小变化；其次，复杂可变形动力学系统固有的混沌特性会迅速将这些微观误差放大为宏观轨迹的分歧。 因此，训练数据并非初始条件的确定性函数。 我们还在 300×300 的 Objaverse 预留场景上进行了大规模验证：对每个场景在相同初始条件下运行两次后，23.7% 的米级场景中，最后一帧的顶点轨迹差异超过了物体尺寸的 1%（约 1 厘米），而 7.7% 的场景中，差异甚至超过了 5%（约 5 厘米）（表 5）。 这种混沌特性也解释了回归模型为何难以应对：面对多种可能分支的未来结果，平方误差损失会将模型推向条件均值，从而将不兼容的结果压缩成一个被衰减的非物理性平均值。 像我们的 LDM 这样的生成方法通过采样合理的轨迹，自然避免了这一问题。 更详细的混沌分析见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 and Fig. 3 evaluate our holistic ST-VAE against two alternative designs: standard temporal compression (the design of video VAEs) and a direct world-coordinate baseline (which applies holistic compression without the factoring of Eq. ( 1 )). All models share a matched compression rate and are assessed across the same three evaluation sets (Appendix E ). The results yield three primary observations. First, holistic temporal compression eliminates staircase artifacts. Standard compression suffers from the staircase artifact (Sec. 4 , Staircase analysis), which shows up as its clearly lower DCC. Our holistic ST-VAE preserves accurate motion timing, achieving a DCC exceeding 0.93 0.93 across all evaluation sets. Furthermore, augmenting the standard baseline with auxiliary velocity or spectral losses, or placing the latent frames adaptively in time, does not mitigate this limitation (Table 7 ). Second, decoupling rigid motion from deformation enhances precision. The direct world-coordinate baseline underperforms the holistic ST-VAE across all deformation and rigid motion metrics, and shows noisy and cluttered geometric detail in the visual comparison (Fig. 3 ). Third, the holistic ST-VAE achieves superior precision across diverse scenarios. Under up to 78 × 78\times compression, the ST-VAE yields a mean geometric reconstruction error of just 2.48 2.48 mm on held-out scenes, representing about half the error of the standard baseline, with a median vertex error below 2 2 mm. It achieves the best performance across nearly all metrics and datasets, except for one rigid-rotation entry where it is a close second. This performance holds robustly zero-shot on OOD sets like GSO and Toys4K, where its errors stay at the same level as in distribution, and on high-resolution meshes exceeding the 5,000 5{,}000 -vertex training cap, where its mean error is still only a few millimeters. The least accurate held-out cases, geometries with many long, thin features, are analyzed in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 和图 3 评估了我们的整体 ST-VAE 与两种替代设计：标准时间压缩（视频 VAE 的设计）以及直接世界坐标基线（该基线应用整体压缩，但不使用公式 (1) 中的分解方法）。 所有模型均共享匹配压缩率，并在相同的三个评估集（附录 E）中进行评估。 结果得出三个主要观察点。 首先，整体时间压缩消除了阶梯状伪影。 标准压缩存在阶梯状伪影（第 4 节，阶梯分析），这体现在其明显较低的 DCC 值上。 我们的整体 ST-VAE 保留了精确的运动时机，在所有评估集中均实现了超过 0.93 的 DCC。 此外，为标准基线增加辅助速度或谱损失，或将潜在帧在时间上自适应地放置，都无法缓解这一局限性（表 7）。 其次，将刚体运动与形变解耦可提升精度。 在所有形变和刚体运动指标中，直接世界坐标基线的表现均劣于整体 ST-VAE；在视觉对比中（图 3），其几何细节显得嘈杂且杂乱。 第三，整体 ST-VAE 在各种场景下均实现了更高的精度。 在高达 78×78 的压缩率下，ST-VAE 在保留场景上的平均几何重建误差仅为 2.48 毫米，约为标准基线误差的一半，且顶点误差中位数低于 2 毫米。 除一个刚体旋转条目外（其中它仅略居第二），它在几乎所有指标和数据集上均表现最佳。 在 GSO 和 Toys4K 等 OOD 数据集上，该模型仍能保持稳健的零样本性能，其误差水平与分布内数据一致；即使对于顶点数超过 5,000 的训练上限的高分辨率网格，其平均误差也仅为几毫米。 精度最低的保留案例——即包含大量细长特征的几何体——在附录 I 中进行了分析。

sents.zh: 结果得出三个主要观察点。

sents.en: First, holistic temporal compression eliminates staircase artifacts.
sents.zh: 首先，整体时间压缩消除了阶梯状伪影。

sents.en: Standard compression suffers from the staircase artifact (Sec. 4 , Staircase analysis), which shows up as its clearly lower DCC.
sents.zh: 标准压缩存在阶梯状伪影（第 4 节，阶梯分析），这体现在其明显较低的 DCC 值上。

sents.en: Our holistic ST-VAE preserves accurate motion timing, achieving a DCC exceeding 0.93 0.93 across all evaluation sets.
sents.zh: 我们的整体 ST-VAE 保留了精确的运动时机，在所有评估集中均实现了超过 0.93 的 DCC。

sents.en: Furthermore, augmenting the standard baseline with auxiliary velocity or spectral losses, or placing the latent frames adaptively in time, does not mitigate this limitation (Table 7 ).
sents.zh: 此外，为标准基线增加辅助速度或谱损失，或将潜在帧在时间上自适应地放置，都无法缓解这一局限性（表 7）。

sents.en: Second, decoupling rigid motion from deformation enhances precision.
sents.zh: 其次，将刚体运动与形变解耦可提升精度。

sents.en: The direct world-coordinate baseline underperforms the holistic ST-VAE across all deformation and rigid motion metrics, and shows noisy and cluttered geometric detail in the visual comparison (Fig. 3 ).
sents.zh: 在所有形变和刚体运动指标中，直接世界坐标基线的表现均劣于整体 ST-VAE；在视觉对比中（图 3），其几何细节显得嘈杂且杂乱。

sents.en: Third, the holistic ST-VAE achieves superior precision across diverse scenarios.
sents.zh: 第三，整体 ST-VAE 在各种场景下均实现了更高的精度。

sents.en: Under up to 78 × 78\times compression, the ST-VAE yields a mean geometric reconstruction error of just 2.48 2.48 mm on held-out scenes, representing about half the error of the standard baseline, with a median vertex error below 2 2 mm.
sents.zh: 在高达 78×78 的压缩率下，ST-VAE 在保留场景上的平均几何重建误差仅为 2.48 毫米，约为标准基线误差的一半，且顶点误差中位数低于 2 毫米。

sents.en: It achieves the best performance across nearly all metrics and datasets, except for one rigid-rotation entry where it is a close second.
sents.zh: 除一个刚体旋转条目外（其中它仅略居第二），它在几乎所有指标和数据集上均表现最佳。

sents.en: This performance holds robustly zero-shot on OOD sets like GSO and Toys4K, where its errors stay at the same level as in distribution, and on high-resolution meshes exceeding the 5,000 5{,}000 -vertex training cap, where its mean error is still only a few millimeters.
sents.zh: 在 GSO 和 Toys4K 等 OOD 数据集上，该模型仍能保持稳健的零样本性能，其误差水平与分布内数据一致；即使对于顶点数超过 5,000 的训练上限的高分辨率网格，其平均误差也仅为几毫米。

sents.en: The least accurate held-out cases, geometries with many long, thin features, are analyzed in Appendix I .
sents.zh: 精度最低的保留案例——即包含大量细长特征的几何体——在附录 I 中进行了分析。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 and Fig. 4 compare three models predicting a 64 64 -frame trajectory from the same initial state: our LDM, a capacity-matched deterministic regression model (both using one-shot prediction and the same ST-VAE), and a frame-by-frame AR graph network based on MeshGraphNets (MGN) (Appendix E.3 ). Because complex deformable dynamics are inherently chaotic, world-space error alone is insufficient to evaluate prediction quality, as the ground truth represents only one of many valid outcomes. Therefore, Table 2 primarily relies on physics-consistency checks (Appendix B ; the full set of checks is in Table 8 ). Across all metrics and datasets, the LDM significantly outperforms both baselines. We highlight three observations from the results. First, the LDM consistently outperforms deterministic regression in generating physically plausible trajectories. The regression model produces damped outputs with geometric artifacts and jitter (e.g., 22.7 % 22.7\% volume violations versus 7.9 % 7.9\% for the LDM on held-out scenes). In contrast, the LDM reduces these artifacts and better preserves the deformation-to-rigid energy ratio. Second, one-shot prediction provides the global temporal context necessary to prevent the compounding errors typically seen in autoregressive models. Consequently, the AR baseline drifts over time and accumulates nearly three times the world-space error of the LDM ( 80.6 80.6 against 28.2 28.2 mm). Third, this strong performance transfers zero-shot to OOD datasets (GSO and Toys4K), demonstrating the robust generalization of our approach. Finally, the LDM remains highly efficient, running at 40 40 to 80 80 frames per second on a single GPU, even for high-resolution meshes exceeding the training cap (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 和图 4 比较了三种模型，这些模型均从相同的初始状态预测 64×64 帧的轨迹：我们的 LDM、一个容量匹配的确定性回归模型（两者均使用单次预测和相同的 ST-VAE），以及基于 MeshGraphNets（MGN）的逐帧 AR 图网络（附录 E.3）。 由于复杂的可变形动态本质上具有混沌性，仅凭世界空间误差不足以评估预测质量，因为真实数据仅代表众多有效结果之一。 因此，表 2 主要依赖物理一致性检查（附录 B；完整的检查集见表 8）。 在所有指标和数据集中，LDM 的表现均显著优于两种基线模型。 我们从结果中重点指出三个观察点。 首先，LDM 在生成物理上合理的轨迹方面始终优于确定性回归模型。 回归模型产生的输出存在阻尼效应、几何伪影和抖动（例如，在保留场景中，体积违反率分别为 22.7% 和 7.9%）。 相比之下，LDM 减少了这些伪影，并更好地保留了形变与刚性能量之比。 其次，单次预测提供了全局时间上下文，这是防止自回归模型中常见的误差累积所必需的。 因此，AR 基线模型会随时间漂移，其世界空间误差累积量几乎是 LDM 的三倍（80.6 毫米对比 28.2 毫米）。 第三，这种强大的性能能够零样本迁移到 OOD 数据集（GSO 和 Toys4K），证明了我们的方法具有稳健的泛化能力。 最后，LDM 仍然非常高效，在单 GPU 上运行速度可达每秒 40 至 80 帧，即使对于超出训练上限的高分辨率网格也是如此（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: The diffusion results in Table 2 use a single sample per scene, which cannot show whether diffusion captures the several possible outcomes of a chaotic scene. To test whether diffusion benefits from modeling several outcomes, we compare the two models separately on chaotic and non-chaotic held-out scenes and draw eight diffusion samples per scene (Appendix D.6 ). Diffusion outperforms regression on both subsets. One may worry that this only reflects a stronger model. However, the diffusion samples spread much more widely on the chaotic scenes, and this spread follows the difference between two runs of the solver. Since the model is the same on both subsets, this effect comes from the generative paradigm and not from a stronger model. A soft key dropped onto the ground illustrates it (Fig. 8 ). Run twice, the solver lets the key fall over in two different directions. Every diffusion sample faithfully falls toward one of the two correct directions, while regression predicts a non-physical average that matches neither run.
paragraphs.zh: 表2中的扩散结果每场景仅使用一个样本，因此无法展示扩散模型是否捕捉到了混乱场景的多种可能结果。 为了检验扩散模型是否因对多种结果的建模而受益，我们在混乱和非混乱的预留场景上分别比较了这两个模型，并为每个场景生成了八个扩散样本（附录D.6）。 在两个子集上，扩散模型的表现均优于回归模型。 有人可能会担心，这仅仅反映了一个更强的模型。 然而，在混乱场景中，扩散样本的分布范围要广泛得多，且这种分布差异反映了求解器两次运行之间的不同结果。 由于两个子集使用的模型相同，这种效果源于生成范式，而非模型本身更强。 一个被掉落到地面上的软键就说明了这一点（图8）。 当运行两次时，求解器会让钥匙朝两个不同的方向倒下。 每个扩散样本都忠实地朝向两个正确方向之一倒下，而回归模型则预测了一个不符合物理规律的平均值，该值与两次运行的结果都不匹配。

paragraphs.en: We remove the ST-VAE and let a DiT of the same capacity as our LDM denoise the vertex × \times frame tokens directly (Table 9 ). Without the latent, one-shot diffusion at native resolution is computationally prohibitive. Memory per sample grows with the vertex count. Even on a 140 140 GiB H200, the model at batch 1 1 runs out of memory at 2,600 2{,}600 vertices. With the latent, the LDM works on a fixed number of tokens and its cost is independent of the vertex count. The vertex-dependent cost moves to the ST-VAE stage, whose training memory grows linearly with N N (Table 9 ), so on the same GPU the training cap rises from about 2,500 2{,}500 vertices without the latent to about 14,000 14{,}000 for ST-VAE Base. The latent also improves the quality of the generated geometry. A raw-coordinate model predicts every vertex directly, so any noise left by the sampler shows up as per-vertex jitter. Our model decodes all vertices from the latent, so the same noise only shifts the shape slightly and coherently (illustrated in Appendix L ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们移除了 ST-VAE，让一个与我们的 LDM 容量相同的 DiT 直接对顶点 × \times 帧的标记进行去噪（表 9）。 如果没有潜在表示，以原生分辨率进行单次扩散的计算成本会高得难以承受。 每个样本的内存占用量会随着顶点数量的增加而增长。 即使在 140 140 GiB 的 H200 上，模型在批处理为 1 1 时，在 2,600 2{,}600 个顶点处就会耗尽内存。 有了潜在表示，LDM 可以在固定数量的标记上运行，其成本与顶点数量无关。 与顶点相关的成本转移到了 ST-VAE 阶段，其训练内存随 N N 线性增长（表 9），因此，在相同的 GPU 上，训练上限从没有潜在表示时的约 2,500 2{,}500 个顶点提升至 ST-VAE Base 的约 14,000 14{,}000 个顶点。 潜在表示还能提升生成几何体的质量。 原始坐标模型会直接预测每个顶点，因此采样器残留的任何噪声都会表现为每个顶点的抖动。 我们的模型从潜在表示中解码所有顶点，因此相同的噪声只会使形状发生轻微且连贯的偏移（如附录 L 所示）。

paragraphs.en: In the ST-VAE (Sec. 3.2 ), the rigid token bypasses the holistic temporal compression and takes its own linear temporal pathway. To test this design, we route the rigid token through the shared holistic temporal compression instead. In our experiments, this one change causes two failures: the translation error explodes, and the reconstructed deformation shrinks drastically (detailed diagnostics in Appendix F ). Further ablations (spatial-VAE pretraining and the decoder GNN) are reported in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 在 ST-VAE（第 3.2 节）中，刚性标记会绕过整体时间压缩机制，并采用其自身的时间线性路径。 为了验证这一设计，我们转而将刚性标记通过共享的整体时间压缩机制进行传输。 在我们的实验中，这一单一改动导致了两个问题：翻译错误急剧上升，而重建的形变则大幅收缩（详细诊断见附录 F）。 更多消融实验结果（空间-VAE 预训练和解码器 GNN）见附录 F。

sents.en: In the ST-VAE (Sec. 3.2 ), the rigid token bypasses the holistic temporal compression and takes its own linear temporal pathway.
sents.zh: 在 ST-VAE（第 3.2 节）中，刚性标记会绕过整体时间压缩机制，并采用其自身的时间线性路径。

sents.en: To test this design, we route the rigid token through the shared holistic temporal compression instead.
sents.zh: 为了验证这一设计，我们转而将刚性标记通过共享的整体时间压缩机制进行传输。

sents.en: In our experiments, this one change causes two failures: the translation error explodes, and the reconstructed deformation shrinks drastically (detailed diagnostics in Appendix F ).
sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，这一单一改动导致了两个问题：翻译错误急剧上升，而重建的形变则大幅收缩（详细诊断见附录 F）。

sents.en: Further ablations (spatial-VAE pretraining and the decoder GNN) are reported in Appendix F .

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the end-to-end differentiability of PhysLDM on two tasks of increasing difficulty and compare against two differentiable simulators, DiffIPC ( Huang et al., 2024b ) and Newton/Warp ( The Newton Contributors, 2025 ) . The detailed comparison, together with the setup and results, is given in Appendix K .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个难度递增的任务中展示了 PhysLDM 的端到端可微性，并将其与两种可微模拟器 DiffIPC（Huang 等人，2024b）和 Newton/Warp（The Newton Contributors，2025）进行了比较。 详细的比较分析以及实验设置和结果见附录 K。

sents.en: We demonstrate the end-to-end differentiability of PhysLDM on two tasks of increasing difficulty and compare against two differentiable simulators, DiffIPC ( Huang et al., 2024b ) and Newton/Warp ( The Newton Contributors, 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 我们在两个难度递增的任务中展示了 PhysLDM 的端到端可微性，并将其与两种可微模拟器 DiffIPC（Huang 等人，2024b）和 Newton/Warp（The Newton Contributors，2025）进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: The bottom-right block of Fig. 1 shows a material estimation task. Given a single simulated trajectory of a body with unknown stiffness, we recover its Young’s modulus E E by gradient descent through the model, since the mismatch to the observed trajectory is differentiable in E E end to end. Because Young’s modulus is usually measured on a logarithmic scale, we optimize E E in log 10 \log_{10} space, where an error of 1 1 dex means a factor of 10 10 . To cover a wide range of stiffness, we repeat the task on seven bodies with moduli from 3 × 10 4 3\times 10^{4} to 3 × 10 6 3\times 10^{6} Pa, each starting from an initial guess up to 1.1 1.1 dex away. In all seven cases, our model recovers E E within 0.06 0.06 dex in 40 40 Adam steps, which takes about 40 40 seconds per run. DiffIPC solves the task only after its solver parameters are tuned by hand, and then needs 26 26 minutes on 48 48 threads. Newton/Warp fails in the backward pass, because backpropagating through its enormous number of substeps explodes the gradient.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 的右下角区块展示了一项材料估计任务。 给定一个刚度未知的物体的单次模拟轨迹，我们通过模型使用梯度下降法恢复其杨氏模量 E，因为与观测轨迹的不匹配在 E 上是端到端可微分的。 由于杨氏模量通常在对数尺度上测量，我们在 log₁₀ 空间中对 E 进行优化，其中 1 dex 的误差意味着 10 倍的差异。 为了覆盖较宽的范围的刚度，我们对七个物体重复该任务，其模量范围从 3×10⁴ Pa 到 3×10⁶ Pa，每个物体的初始猜测值最多偏离真实值 1.1 dex。 在所有七种情况下，我们的模型在 40 次 Adam 步骤内将 E 的恢复误差控制在 0.06 dex 以内，每次运行大约需要 40 秒。 DiffIPC 只有在手动调整其求解器参数后才能解决该任务，即便如此也需要在 48 个线程上运行 26 分钟。 Newton/Warp 在反向传播阶段失败，因为通过其庞大的子步数进行反向传播会导致梯度爆炸。

sents.en: The bottom-right block of Fig. 1 shows a material estimation task.
sents.zh: 图 1 的右下角区块展示了一项材料估计任务。

sents.en: Given a single simulated trajectory of a body with unknown stiffness, we recover its Young’s modulus E E by gradient descent through the model, since the mismatch to the observed trajectory is differentiable in E E end to end.
sents.zh: 给定一个刚度未知的物体的单次模拟轨迹，我们通过模型使用梯度下降法恢复其杨氏模量 E，因为与观测轨迹的不匹配在 E 上是端到端可微分的。

sents.en: Because Young’s modulus is usually measured on a logarithmic scale, we optimize E E in log 10 \log_{10} space, where an error of 1 1 dex means a factor of 10 10 .
sents.zh: 由于杨氏模量通常在对数尺度上测量，我们在 log₁₀ 空间中对 E 进行优化，其中 1 dex 的误差意味着 10 倍的差异。

sents.en: To cover a wide range of stiffness, we repeat the task on seven bodies with moduli from 3 × 10 4 3\times 10^{4} to 3 × 10 6 3\times 10^{6} Pa, each starting from an initial guess up to 1.1 1.1 dex away.
sents.zh: 为了覆盖较宽的范围的刚度，我们对七个物体重复该任务，其模量范围从 3×10⁴ Pa 到 3×10⁶ Pa，每个物体的初始猜测值最多偏离真实值 1.1 dex。

sents.en: In all seven cases, our model recovers E E within 0.06 0.06 dex in 40 40 Adam steps, which takes about 40 40 seconds per run.
sents.zh: 在所有七种情况下，我们的模型在 40 次 Adam 步骤内将 E 的恢复误差控制在 0.06 dex 以内，每次运行大约需要 40 秒。

sents.en: DiffIPC solves the task only after its solver parameters are tuned by hand, and then needs 26 26 minutes on 48 48 threads.
sents.zh: DiffIPC 只有在手动调整其求解器参数后才能解决该任务，即便如此也需要在 48 个线程上运行 26 分钟。

sents.en: Newton/Warp fails in the backward pass, because backpropagating through its enormous number of substeps explodes the gradient.
sents.zh: Newton/Warp 在反向传播阶段失败，因为通过其庞大的子步数进行反向传播会导致梯度爆炸。

paragraphs.en: Based on the first task, we may ask a further question: which throw reveals the stiffness best, so that the estimation above becomes easier? Easier means that a change of E E produces a larger change of the trajectory, so the trajectory carries more information about the stiffness. We therefore maximize the sensitivity of the predicted trajectory to E E over the release velocity by gradient ascent through the model. The objective is a derivative, so its gradient is a second-order quantity. Our model supports higher-order derivatives through the automatic differentiation of PyTorch, so it provides this gradient directly, and 30 30 Adam steps finish the design in 7 7 minutes. Replayed in the ground-truth simulator, the optimized throw makes the rigid motion 13 × 13\times more sensitive to the stiffness. DiffIPC offers only first-order derivatives and cannot be applied directly to this second-order task. A workaround is to obtain the second-order gradient by nested finite differences, but then DiffIPC is about 635 × 635\times slower than our model per gradient step. The whole design would take several days, which is not acceptable in practice. Newton/Warp does not produce a usable first-order gradient on this scene, so a second-order one is out of reach.
paragraphs.zh: 基于第一个任务，我们可以提出一个进一步的问题：哪种投掷方式能最好地揭示刚度，从而使上述估计变得更简单？ “更简单”意味着 E 的变化会引起轨迹更大的变化，因此轨迹携带了更多关于刚度的信息。 因此，我们通过模型中的梯度上升法，将预测轨迹对释放速度的敏感度相对于 E 最大化。 目标函数是一个导数，因此其梯度是一个二阶量。 我们的模型通过 PyTorch 的自动微分支持更高阶的导数，因此可以直接提供该梯度，并且 30 个 Adam 步骤可在 7 分钟内完成设计。 在真实模拟环境中重演时，优化后的投掷使刚性运动对刚度的敏感度提高了 13 倍。 DiffIPC 仅提供一阶导数，无法直接应用于这个二阶任务。 一种变通方法是使用嵌套有限差分法获取二阶梯度，但此时 DiffIPC 每个梯度步骤的速度比我们的模型慢约 635 倍。 整个设计过程将需要数天时间，这在实践中是不可接受的。 Newton/Warp 在该场景下无法生成可用的梯度，因此二阶梯度更是无从谈起。

paragraphs.en: We introduce PhysLDM, a latent diffusion paradigm for predicting the dynamics of high-fidelity volumetric deformable bodies. To overcome the computational limits of processing high-resolution meshes, we developed a novel holistic ST-VAE that explicitly disentangles global rigid motion from local deformations. This architecture eliminates the staircase artifacts inherent to standard temporal compression, ensuring highly accurate trajectory reconstruction even for high-resolution, out-of-distribution meshes. Operating on this compact latent representation, we demonstrate that while deterministic regression produces damped, non-physical averages in this chaotic regime, our generative approach predicts physically consistent trajectories in a single diffusion pass. Finally, trained purely kinematically, PhysLDM delivers robust zero-shot generalization and provides end-to-end differentiability, unlocking complex inverse design optimizations that remain intractable for traditional solvers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PhysLDM，这是一种潜在扩散范式，用于预测高保真体积可变形体的动态变化。 为克服处理高分辨率网格时的计算限制，我们开发了一种新颖的整体性 ST-VAE，能够明确地将全局刚性运动与局部形变分离开来。 这种架构消除了标准时间压缩固有的阶梯状伪影，确保即使对于高分辨率且超出分布范围的网格，也能实现高度准确的轨迹重建。 基于这一紧凑的潜在表示，我们证明：尽管确定性回归在此混沌机制中会产生衰减的非物理平均值，但我们的生成方法仅需单次扩散过程即可预测出物理上自洽的轨迹。 最后，PhysLDM 完全通过运动学训练，实现了稳健的零样本泛化能力，并提供了端到端的可微分性，从而开启了传统求解器难以处理的复杂逆向设计优化。

sents.en: This architecture eliminates the staircase artifacts inherent to standard temporal compression, ensuring highly accurate trajectory reconstruction even for high-resolution, out-of-distribution meshes.

sents.en: Operating on this compact latent representation, we demonstrate that while deterministic regression produces damped, non-physical averages in this chaotic regime, our generative approach predicts physically consistent trajectories in a single diffusion pass.
sents.zh: 基于这一紧凑的潜在表示，我们证明：尽管确定性回归在此混沌机制中会产生衰减的非物理平均值，但我们的生成方法仅需单次扩散过程即可预测出物理上自洽的轨迹。

sents.en: Finally, trained purely kinematically, PhysLDM delivers robust zero-shot generalization and provides end-to-end differentiability, unlocking complex inverse design optimizations that remain intractable for traditional solvers.

paragraphs.en: Limitations and Future Work. Currently, our model focuses on predicting 64 64 -frame trajectories in a single diffusion pass. Extending this one-shot approach into an autoregressive framework presents a promising direction for future research.

paragraphs.en: Our model is trained in three stages, one per component: the spatial VAE for 183 183 k iterations, ST-VAE Base for 150 150 k iterations, and the LDM for 278 278 k iterations. The three stages together take about 7 7 days on 8 8 H200 GPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的模型分三个阶段训练，每个阶段对应一个组件：空间 VAE 训练 183 183 k 次迭代，ST-VAE Base 训练 150 150 k 次迭代，LDM 训练 278 278 k 次迭代。 这三个阶段总共在 8 8 块 H200 GPU 上运行约 7 7 天。

sents.en: Our model is trained in three stages, one per component: the spatial VAE for 183 183 k iterations, ST-VAE Base for 150 150 k iterations, and the LDM for 278 278 k iterations.

sents.en: The three stages together take about 7 7 days on 8 8 H200 GPUs.
sents.zh: 这三个阶段总共在 8 8 块 H200 GPU 上运行约 7 7 天。

paragraphs.en: The spatial VAE is an 8 8 -layer transformer of hidden width 512 512 ( 44 44 M parameters). Its input is one frame in canonical coordinates, i.e. the rest shape plus the deformation 𝐝 t \mathbf{d}_{t} of Eq. ( 1 ) with the rigid motion removed. The encoder cross-attends K = 512 K{=}512 learned query tokens against the N N vertex tokens of the frame and outputs K K latent tokens of width D = 48 D{=}48 , independent of N N . We denote the latent of frame t t by 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t} . The decoder mirrors the encoder: the N N rest vertices, embedded with their positions, cross-attend the latent tokens and are decoded back to their N N displacements. The decoder additionally takes the mesh topology as input, because a shallow GNN over the tetrahedral mesh then refines the decoded displacements. The spatial VAE is trained first with a Charbonnier position loss and a KL term.
paragraphs.zh: 空间 VAE 是一个隐藏层宽度为 512（共 4400 万个参数）的 8×8 层 Transformer。其输入是规范坐标系下的一个帧，即静止形状加上公式 (1) 中已去除刚体运动的形变 𝐝 t \mathbf{d}_{t}。编码器将 K = 512 个学习到的查询标记与帧中的 N 个顶点标记进行交叉注意力计算，并输出宽度为 D = 48 的 K 个潜在标记，该输出与 N 无关。我们将第 t 帧的潜在表示为 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t}。解码器的结构与编码器对称：N 个静止顶点在嵌入其位置后，会与潜在标记进行交叉注意力计算，并解码回其 N 个位移。此外，解码器还会将网格拓扑作为输入，因为随后会对四面体网格执行一次浅层 GNN，以进一步优化解码出的位移。空间 VAE 首先使用 Charbonnier 位置损失和 KL 项进行训练。

paragraphs.en: The per-frame latents { 𝐳 t } t = 1 T \{\mathbf{z}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} are processed by a stack of factorized space–time attention blocks ( Ho et al., 2019 ; Bertasius et al., 2021 ; Arnab et al., 2021 ) . The holistic temporal compression then summarizes the time axis: M M learned query tokens attend over each spatial token’s T T -frame sequence, and only these M M outputs are kept as the temporal representation, while the T T per-frame outputs are discarded. The rigid-motion token bypasses this attention compression and is compressed by a separate linear temporal path. The two are kept apart because the rigid signal is orders of magnitude larger than the deformation and, when the two share one compression path, takes over the shared latent and starves the deformation track (Sec. 4.1 , Appendix F ). The two tracks then merge: the joint latent is 𝐙 ∈ ℝ M × ( K + 1 ) × D \mathbf{Z}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times(K+1)\times D} of Sec. 3.2 , i.e. M M temporal tokens for each of the K K deformation tokens and the rigid token, each of width D = 48 D{=}48 . The decoder mirrors the encoder: per-frame queries attend over the M M temporal tokens to recover a latent for every frame, which the spatial VAE decoder turns into vertex positions. Table 3 lists the two ST-VAE configurations used in this paper, ST-VAE Small for the controlled comparisons of Table 1 and ST-VAE Base for the LDM experiments (Sec. 4 ). Both configurations compress a trajectory by the same factor, counted in tokens. The input has one token per vertex per frame, T × N T\times N tokens in total, and the latent has M × ( K + 1 ) M\times(K{+}1) tokens. Since T / M = 8 T/M{=}8 and K + 1 = 513 K{+}1{=}513 in both configurations, the token compression ratio is 8 ​ N / 513 8N/513 , which reaches 78 × 78\times at the 5,000 5{,}000 -vertex cap.

paragraphs.en: All simulation data are generated with StiffGIPC ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , a GPU IPC solver. IPC solvers are widely adopted in scenarios that demand high simulation accuracy, such as embodied AI ( Kim et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Such a solver runs offline. Learning its behavior and turning it into a fast, fully differentiable neural simulator is therefore of practical importance. All 3D meshes used for training come from the Objaverse dataset ( Deitke et al., 2023 ) . Each asset is voxel-remeshed to a watertight surface, tetrahedralized with fTetWild ( Hu et al., 2020 ) , reduced to its largest connected component, and rescaled to a unit bounding box. Meshes with more than 10,000 10{,}000 vertices are discarded, and the ST-VAE and the LDM are trained on scenes with 500 500 – 5,000 5{,}000 vertices. Every scene drops one meter-scale solid onto a ground plane. The object is released with its lowest point 0.85 0.85 to 1.65 1.65 m above the ground. Each object receives a random initial velocity v 0 v_{0} and a random stiffness E E (a horizontal v 0 ∼ U ⁡ ( 0 , 2 ) v_{0}\sim U(0,2) m/s and a Young’s modulus E E log-uniform in [ 3 × 10 4 , 3 × 10 6 ] [3\times 10^{4},3\times 10^{6}] Pa) under a Stable Neo-Hookean material. Multi-body scenes follow the same setting with two or three objects, each with its own E E and v 0 v_{0} , thrown toward each other so that they collide in mid-air before reaching the ground. In total, the dataset contains 63,397 63{,}397 single-object and 16,078 16{,}078 multi-body simulated trajectories. The simulation time step is 1 / 60 1/60 s, and each trajectory has 64 64 frames. Held-out scenes are excluded from all three training stages, and every reported number is computed on these held-out scenes or on the OOD sets. For OOD evaluation we generate 1,015 1{,}015 GSO and 3,814 3{,}814 Toys4K scenes under the identical simulation setting. They never appear in training.
paragraphs.zh: 所有模拟数据均使用 StiffGIPC（Huang 等人，2025）生成，这是一种 GPU IPC 求解器。 IPC 求解器被广泛采用于需要高模拟精度的场景，例如具身人工智能（Kim 等人，2022；Li 等人，2025）。 此类求解器以离线方式运行。 因此，学习其行为并将其转化为快速且完全可微分的神经模拟器具有实际意义。 所有用于训练的三维网格均来自 Objaverse 数据集（Deitke 等人，2023）。 每个资产都通过体素重网格化为无泄漏表面，使用 fTetWild（Hu 等人，2020）进行四面体化，然后缩减至其最大的连通分支，并重新缩放到单位边界框内。 顶点数超过 10,000 的网格会被丢弃，而 ST-VAE 和 LDM 则在包含 500–5,000 个顶点的场景上进行训练。 每个场景都会将一个一米尺度的固体物体放置在平面上。 该物体从距离地面 0.85 至 1.65 米的高度释放，其最低点位于此范围内。 在稳定的新胡克材料模型下，每个物体都会被赋予一个随机初始速度 v₀ 和一个随机刚度 E（水平方向的 v₀ ∼ U(0,2) m/s，杨氏模量 E 在 [3×10⁴, 3×10⁶] Pa 范围内呈对数均匀分布）。 多物体场景遵循相同的设置，包含两个或三个物体，每个物体都有自己的 E 和 v₀，它们相互投掷，以便在空中相撞，而不是先到达地面。 该数据集总共包含 63,397 条单物体模拟轨迹和 16,078 条多物体模拟轨迹。 模拟的时间步长为 1/60 秒，每条轨迹包含 64 帧。 预留场景被排除在所有三个训练阶段之外，所有报告的数值均基于这些预留场景或 OOD 数据集计算得出。 对于 OOD 评估，我们在相同的模拟设置下生成了 1,015 个 GSO 场景和 3,814 个 Toys4K 场景。 这些场景从未出现在训练过程中。

paragraphs.en: DCC (deformation-change correlation): the deformation change of a trajectory at frame t t is the mean vertex displacement between two consecutive frames in canonical (rigid-free) coordinates, v ⁡ ( t ) = mean v ​ ∥ 𝐝 t + 1 , v − 𝐝 t , v ∥ v(t)=\mathrm{mean}_{v}\lVert\mathbf{d}_{t+1,v}-\mathbf{d}_{t,v}\rVert , where 𝐝 t , v \mathbf{d}_{t,v} is the position of vertex v v in the deformation field 𝐝 t \mathbf{d}_{t} . The deformation-change curve is v ⁡ ( t ) v(t) over the trajectory. DCC is the Pearson correlation between the deformation-change curves of the reconstruction and of the ground truth. It is reported as the mean across scenes. It detects the staircase artifact directly, since holds suppress the speed and snaps spike it. This metric is amplitude-invariant, so it does not reflect reconstruction quality on its own and should be considered together with the other metrics.
paragraphs.zh: DCC（形变变化相关性）：轨迹在帧 t 处的形变变化是指在标准坐标（无刚性变换）下，两个连续帧之间的平均顶点位移，v⁡(t)=mean_v‖𝒅_{t+1,v}−𝒅_{t,v}‖，其中 𝒅_{t,v} 是顶点 v 在形变场 𝒅_t 中的位置。 形变变化曲线是沿轨迹的 v⁡(t) 值。 DCC 是重建结果与真实参考数据的形变变化曲线之间的皮尔逊相关性。 该指标以跨场景的平均值形式报告。 它能直接检测阶梯状伪影，因为保持操作会抑制速度，而快照操作会使速度出现尖峰。 该指标具有振幅不变性，因此单独使用时无法反映重建质量，应与其他指标结合考虑。

paragraphs.en: Recon (geometric reconstruction error; mean / med / P90): the encode–decode error of the deformation field, i.e. the per-vertex Euclidean error of the rigid-free deformation 𝐝 t \mathbf{d}_{t} averaged over vertices and frames of a scene (mm). The three columns are the mean, median, and 90th percentile across scenes. The 90th percentile reflects the hardest 10 % 10\% of scenes. For the direct world-coordinate baseline, which has no deformation field of its own, a rigid transform is fitted to each output frame by the Kabsch algorithm, and the residual after removing it is scored as the deformation error.
paragraphs.zh: 重建（几何重建误差；均值 / 中位数 / P90）：形变场的编码-解码误差，即刚性自由形变 𝐝 t \mathbf{d}_{t} 每个顶点的欧氏误差，对场景中各顶点和帧取平均（毫米）。 三列分别表示跨场景的均值、中位数和第 90 百分位数。 第 90 百分位数反映了最难处理的 10% 的场景。 对于没有自身形变场的直接世界坐标基线方法，通过 Kabsch 算法为每个输出帧拟合刚性变换，移除该变换后的残差即被计为形变误差。

paragraphs.en: All of these metrics are computed from the predicted and ground-truth trajectories alone and do not require knowledge of the underlying constitutive model. The violation rates are defined as follows. A physical quantity (speed or acceleration) is computed for every vertex at every frame, once from the prediction and once from the ground truth. Each such vertex-frame pair is one sample. A sample is counted as a violation if the predicted value is more than twice, or less than half, the ground-truth value. The violation rate is the fraction of violated samples. Samples whose ground-truth value is too small to be meaningful are excluded by a magnitude threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 所有这些指标都仅根据预测轨迹和真实轨迹计算得出，无需了解底层的本构模型。 违反率的定义如下。 每一帧中每个顶点的物理量（速度或加速度）都会被计算两次：一次基于预测值，一次基于真实值。 每个这样的顶点-帧组合即为一个样本。 如果预测值超过真实值的两倍，或低于真实值的一半，则该样本被视为违反样本。 违反率即违反样本所占的比例。 真实值过小、无实际意义的样本会通过幅度阈值被排除。

sents.en: Each such vertex-frame pair is one sample.

paragraphs.en: Volume viol. (volume violation rate): this measures whether the prediction preserves volume where the ground truth does. For every tetrahedron at every frame, we compute how much its volume differs from its rest volume, once in the ground truth and once in the prediction. We look only at the cases where the ground truth changes the volume by less than 3 % 3\% , because there the ground truth preserves volume. Among these cases, a violation is one where the prediction changes the volume by more than 10 % 10\% . The rate is the fraction of violations.
paragraphs.zh: 体积违规。 （体积违规率）：该指标衡量预测结果是否在真实数据保持体积的地方也保持了体积。 对于每一帧中的每个四面体，我们都会计算其体积与静止体积的差异，分别基于真实数据和预测数据。 我们仅关注真实数据中体积变化小于 3%（3\%）的情况，因为在这种情况下真实数据保持了体积。 在这些情况中，如果预测结果导致体积变化超过 10%（10\%），则视为违规。 该比率即为违规案例所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: and the reported value is ( K ​ E def / K ​ E rig ) pred / ( K ​ E def / K ​ E rig ) GT (KE_{\mathrm{def}}/KE_{\mathrm{rig}})_{\mathrm{pred}}\,/\,(KE_{\mathrm{def}}/KE_{\mathrm{rig}})_{\mathrm{GT}} , taken as the median across scenes. Scenes where the ground truth barely deforms (deformation below 1 % 1\% of the kinetic energy) are skipped. At impact, the kinetic energy of the object is divided between the motion of the object as a whole and the internal motion that deforms it. How much goes into deformation depends on how soft the object is and how hard it hits. The ground truth gives the correct proportion for the same object and the same impact, so comparing the two ratios shows whether the prediction moves energy into deformation the way the GPU solver does. A value below 1 1 means the prediction deforms less than the ground truth and moves more rigidly. A value above 1 1 would mean unphysical deformation or jitter. In Table 2 every model is below 1 1 , and the regression model is the lowest on all three evaluation sets, consistent with the damped averages discussed in Sec. 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 报告的值是 (KE_def/KE_rig)_pred / (KE_def/KE_rig)_GT，取各场景的中位数。 地面真相几乎不发生形变（形变低于动能的 1%）的场景会被跳过。 在碰撞时，物体的动能会分配给物体整体的运动以及使其发生形变的内部运动。 分配到形变的能量多少取决于物体的柔软程度和撞击的强度。 对于同一物体和同一次撞击，地面真相提供了正确的比例，因此比较这两个比率可以显示预测是否像 GPU 求解器那样将能量转移到形变中。 低于 1 的值表示预测中的形变比地面真相少，且运动更刚体。 高于 1 的值则意味着非物理性的形变或抖动。 在表 2 中，所有模型的值都低于 1，而回归模型在所有三个评估集上的值最低，这与第 4 节中讨论的阻尼平均值一致。

paragraphs.en: World err (world-coordinate error): the per-vertex Euclidean error in world coordinates against the ground-truth trajectory, averaged over vertices and frames, reported as the median across scenes (mm). Because deformable dynamics are chaotic, the ground truth may be only one of many possible outcomes, so this number is a reference and not a full measure of prediction quality.
paragraphs.zh: 世界坐标误差（world-coordinate error）：每个顶点在世界坐标系中与真实轨迹之间的欧氏误差，按顶点和帧进行平均，并以跨场景的中位数表示（毫米）。 由于可变形动力学具有混沌性，真实结果可能只是众多可能结果之一，因此该数值仅作为参考，而非预测质量的完整衡量标准。

paragraphs.en: This section diagnoses the staircase artifact. It appears in four baselines of Table 7 : the standard baseline, its two variants (velocity loss and spectral loss), and adaptive compression. The architectures of these baselines are described in Appendix E.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 本节对阶梯型人工制品进行诊断。 它出现在表 7 的四种基线中：标准基线、其两种变体（速度损失和谱损失）以及自适应压缩。 这些基线的架构在附录 E.1 中有详细说明。

sents.en: This section diagnoses the staircase artifact.
sents.zh: 本节对阶梯型人工制品进行诊断。

sents.en: It appears in four baselines of Table 7 : the standard baseline, its two variants (velocity loss and spectral loss), and adaptive compression.
sents.zh: 它出现在表 7 的四种基线中：标准基线、其两种变体（速度损失和谱损失）以及自适应压缩。

sents.en: The architectures of these baselines are described in Appendix E.1 .
sents.zh: 这些基线的架构在附录 E.1 中有详细说明。

paragraphs.en: The symptom is wrong timing of rapid motion. Where the ground truth changes quickly, for instance at impact, the reconstruction holds its shape for several frames and then jumps to catch up, so the motion arrives late and all at once. We diagnose it in three ways. Fig. 5 plots the deformation-change curve on five scenes. The curves of the standard baseline, its two variants, and adaptive compression stay below ground truth for several frames and then overshoot it in one frame. The holistic ST-VAE follows the ground truth, and so does the direct world-coordinate baseline, which uses the same holistic temporal compression. Fig. 6 shows the same behavior directly on the silhouettes of one scene. The silhouettes of the standard baseline and its variants change less than the ground truth for three frames and then more than it in the last one or two frames. Adaptive compression changes less than the ground truth over all five frame pairs and releases the motion even later. The direct world-coordinate baseline follows the ground truth until the last pair. Table 4 scores the five scenes with DCC. The holistic ST-VAE is the best or tied on every scene.
paragraphs.zh: 这种症状表现为快速运动的时机错误。 当真实数据变化迅速时（例如在碰撞瞬间），重建结果会保持其形状数帧，然后突然跳跃以追赶变化，导致运动延迟并一次性完成。 我们通过三种方式诊断这一问题。 图5绘制了五个场景中的形变变化曲线。 标准基线、其两种变体以及自适应压缩的曲线在数帧内低于真实数据，然后在一帧内超过真实数据。 整体ST-VAE能够跟随真实数据，使用相同整体时间压缩的直接世界坐标基线也是如此。 图6直接展示了同一场景轮廓中的相同行为。 标准基线及其变体的轮廓在前三帧内的变化小于真实数据，而在最后的一到两帧内则大于真实数据。 自适应压缩在所有五对帧中的变化均小于真实数据，并且运动释放得更晚。 直接世界坐标基线一直跟随真实数据，直到最后一对帧。 表4使用DCC对五个场景进行了评分。 整体ST-VAE在每个场景中的表现均为最佳或并列最佳。

paragraphs.en: In the standard baseline, the decoded frames at the latent-frame positions are accurate, and the frames between them carry the error. The most likely cause is that standard compression summarizes every k k frames into one latent frame and loses the high-frequency temporal information that says when, within those k k frames, the rapid change happens. One might think that the problem is a mismatch between neighboring blocks. This is not the case. Two observations show that the error builds up inside each block. First, the standard baseline moves too little during the early frames of every block and then catches up in the last frames, whereas the ground truth moves at a steady pace throughout the block. Second, smoothing the reconstruction across block boundaries does not remove the artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准基线模型中，位于潜在帧位置处的解码帧是准确的，而它们之间的帧则携带了误差。 最可能的原因是，标准压缩方法将每 k 个帧汇总为一个潜在帧，从而丢失了高频时间信息——这些信息原本用于说明在这些 k 个帧内，快速变化具体发生在何时。 有人可能会认为，这个问题源于相邻块之间的不匹配。但事实并非如此。 两点观察表明，误差是在每个块内部逐渐累积的。 首先，在每个块的早期帧中，标准基线模型的运动幅度过小，而在最后几帧才追赶上实际运动；相比之下，真实轨迹在整个块内都以稳定的速度移动。 其次，对跨块边界的重建结果进行平滑处理也无法消除这种伪影。

sents.en: In the standard baseline, the decoded frames at the latent-frame positions are accurate, and the frames between them carry the error.
sents.zh: 在标准基线模型中，位于潜在帧位置处的解码帧是准确的，而它们之间的帧则携带了误差。

sents.en: The most likely cause is that standard compression summarizes every k k frames into one latent frame and loses the high-frequency temporal information that says when, within those k k frames, the rapid change happens.

sents.zh: 有人可能会认为，这个问题源于相邻块之间的不匹配。但事实并非如此。

sents.en: Two observations show that the error builds up inside each block.
sents.zh: 两点观察表明，误差是在每个块内部逐渐累积的。

sents.en: First, the standard baseline moves too little during the early frames of every block and then catches up in the last frames, whereas the ground truth moves at a steady pace throughout the block.
sents.zh: 首先，在每个块的早期帧中，标准基线模型的运动幅度过小，而在最后几帧才追赶上实际运动；相比之下，真实轨迹在整个块内都以稳定的速度移动。

sents.en: Second, smoothing the reconstruction across block boundaries does not remove the artifact.
sents.zh: 其次，对跨块边界的重建结果进行平滑处理也无法消除这种伪影。

paragraphs.en: The two variants of the standard baseline and the adaptive-compression baseline all keep the approach of standard temporal compression: they compress the trajectory into a fixed number of latent frames and then reconstruct the frames by local temporal upsampling, so they leave the artifact in place. The velocity loss and the spectral loss change the training signal only. The standard baseline still cannot place the rapid change at the right instant between two latent frames. Adaptive compression moves the latent frames toward the impact, which makes the steps fewer but steeper. A likely reason is that the rebound and settling phases are left with one or two latent frames, so their motion is released in a late snap. The direct world-coordinate baseline uses the holistic temporal compression and shows almost no staircase. Its high DCC in Table 4 together with its lower precision in Table 1 shows that its weakness is precision rather than timing.
paragraphs.zh: 标准基线和自适应压缩基线的两种变体都沿用了标准的时序压缩方法：它们将轨迹压缩为固定数量的潜在帧，然后通过局部时序上采样重建这些帧，因此保留了原始的人工痕迹。 速度损失和光谱损失仅改变了训练信号。 标准基线仍然无法在两个潜在帧之间正确定位快速变化的瞬间。 自适应压缩将潜在帧向撞击点移动，这使得步骤更少但更陡峭。 一个可能的原因是，反弹和稳定阶段仅保留了一到两个潜在帧，因此它们的运动被延迟地一次性释放出来。 直接世界坐标基线采用了整体时序压缩方法，几乎没有出现阶梯状结构。 表4中其较高的DCC值与表1中较低的精度相结合，表明其弱点在于精度而非时机。

sents.en: The two variants of the standard baseline and the adaptive-compression baseline all keep the approach of standard temporal compression: they compress the trajectory into a fixed number of latent frames and then reconstruct the frames by local temporal upsampling, so they leave the artifact in place.
sents.zh: 标准基线和自适应压缩基线的两种变体都沿用了标准的时序压缩方法：它们将轨迹压缩为固定数量的潜在帧，然后通过局部时序上采样重建这些帧，因此保留了原始的人工痕迹。

sents.en: The velocity loss and the spectral loss change the training signal only.
sents.zh: 速度损失和光谱损失仅改变了训练信号。

sents.en: The standard baseline still cannot place the rapid change at the right instant between two latent frames.
sents.zh: 标准基线仍然无法在两个潜在帧之间正确定位快速变化的瞬间。

sents.en: Adaptive compression moves the latent frames toward the impact, which makes the steps fewer but steeper.
sents.zh: 自适应压缩将潜在帧向撞击点移动，这使得步骤更少但更陡峭。

sents.en: A likely reason is that the rebound and settling phases are left with one or two latent frames, so their motion is released in a late snap.
sents.zh: 一个可能的原因是，反弹和稳定阶段仅保留了一到两个潜在帧，因此它们的运动被延迟地一次性释放出来。

sents.en: The direct world-coordinate baseline uses the holistic temporal compression and shows almost no staircase.
sents.zh: 直接世界坐标基线采用了整体时序压缩方法，几乎没有出现阶梯状结构。

sents.en: Its high DCC in Table 4 together with its lower precision in Table 1 shows that its weakness is precision rather than timing.
sents.zh: 表4中其较高的DCC值与表1中较低的精度相结合，表明其弱点在于精度而非时机。

paragraphs.en: This section gives the details of the chaos experiment in Sec. 4 (Chaos analysis). A common assumption is that a physics simulator produces a deterministic trajectory once the initial state and parameters are fully specified. In practice, this is not guaranteed for modern GPU solvers. Because of their speed, GPU solvers are increasingly used to generate physical simulation data at scale, so the consequences of this non-determinism for learning deserve a closer look. Two separate facts are involved. First, a GPU solver is not bit-reproducible: its parallel reductions add floating-point numbers in a different order on every run, which perturbs the state at the level of rounding error. On its own this would be harmless. Second, the complex dynamics of deformable bodies are chaotic: it can amplify such a perturbation into a macroscopic difference in the outcome. The experiment below separates the two.
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细介绍了第 4 节（混沌分析）中的混沌实验。 一个常见的假设是，一旦初始状态和参数被完全指定，物理模拟器就会生成一条确定性的轨迹。 实际上，现代 GPU 求解器并不保证这一点。 由于速度快，GPU 求解器正越来越多地用于大规模生成物理模拟数据，因此这种非确定性对学习的影响值得更深入的探讨。 这里涉及两个独立的事实。 首先，GPU 求解器不具备位级可重复性：其并行归约操作在每次运行时都会以不同的顺序对浮点数进行累加，从而在舍入误差层面扰动系统状态。 单凭这一点本身并不会造成危害。 其次，可变形物体的复杂动力学具有混沌性：它可能将这种微小扰动放大为结果上的宏观差异。 下面的实验将这两个因素区分开来。

sents.en: This section gives the details of the chaos experiment in Sec. 4 (Chaos analysis).
sents.zh: 本节详细介绍了第 4 节（混沌分析）中的混沌实验。

sents.en: A common assumption is that a physics simulator produces a deterministic trajectory once the initial state and parameters are fully specified.
sents.zh: 一个常见的假设是，一旦初始状态和参数被完全指定，物理模拟器就会生成一条确定性的轨迹。

sents.en: In practice, this is not guaranteed for modern GPU solvers.
sents.zh: 实际上，现代 GPU 求解器并不保证这一点。

sents.en: Because of their speed, GPU solvers are increasingly used to generate physical simulation data at scale, so the consequences of this non-determinism for learning deserve a closer look.
sents.zh: 由于速度快，GPU 求解器正越来越多地用于大规模生成物理模拟数据，因此这种非确定性对学习的影响值得更深入的探讨。

sents.en: Two separate facts are involved.
sents.zh: 这里涉及两个独立的事实。

sents.en: First, a GPU solver is not bit-reproducible: its parallel reductions add floating-point numbers in a different order on every run, which perturbs the state at the level of rounding error.
sents.zh: 首先，GPU 求解器不具备位级可重复性：其并行归约操作在每次运行时都会以不同的顺序对浮点数进行累加，从而在舍入误差层面扰动系统状态。

sents.en: On its own this would be harmless.
sents.zh: 单凭这一点本身并不会造成危害。

sents.en: Second, the complex dynamics of deformable bodies are chaotic: it can amplify such a perturbation into a macroscopic difference in the outcome.
sents.zh: 其次，可变形物体的复杂动力学具有混沌性：它可能将这种微小扰动放大为结果上的宏观差异。

sents.en: The experiment below separates the two.
sents.zh: 下面的实验将这两个因素区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We take one held-out scene, a soft tennis racket dropped onto the ground, and run the GPU solver five times on the same GPU from byte-identical inputs: the same tetrahedral mesh, initial state, material parameters, and solver configuration. To measure how far two runs drift apart at a given frame, we compute the displacement of every vertex between the two runs and report the largest one as a fraction of the object’s extent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选取一个预留的场景——一个软质网球拍掉落在地面上，并使用相同的 GPU 对完全一致的字节输入（即相同的四面体网格、初始状态、材料参数和求解器配置）运行 GPU 求解器五次。 为了衡量两次运行在某一帧上偏离的程度，我们会计算两次运行中每个顶点的位移，并将最大的位移值作为物体尺寸的一个比例进行报告。

sents.en: We take one held-out scene, a soft tennis racket dropped onto the ground, and run the GPU solver five times on the same GPU from byte-identical inputs: the same tetrahedral mesh, initial state, material parameters, and solver configuration.
sents.zh: 我们选取一个预留的场景——一个软质网球拍掉落在地面上，并使用相同的 GPU 对完全一致的字节输入（即相同的四面体网格、初始状态、材料参数和求解器配置）运行 GPU 求解器五次。

sents.en: To measure how far two runs drift apart at a given frame, we compute the displacement of every vertex between the two runs and report the largest one as a fraction of the object’s extent.
sents.zh: 为了衡量两次运行在某一帧上偏离的程度，我们会计算两次运行中每个顶点的位移，并将最大的位移值作为物体尺寸的一个比例进行报告。

paragraphs.en: The non-determinism of the solver is real but minute. After the first simulation step the five runs differ by at most 0.02 0.02 mm, two hundred-thousandths of the object size. Before the racket reaches the ground, the runs still differ by at most 3 % 3\% of the object size, mostly in the strings of the net, and their centres of mass by less than 1 1 mm. Until the racket reaches the ground, the five runs are therefore practically identical.
paragraphs.zh: 求解器的非确定性是真实存在的，但非常微小。 在第一步模拟之后，五次运行的差异最多为 0.02 毫米，即物体尺寸的二十万分之二。 在球拍触地之前，各次运行的差异仍然最多为物体尺寸的 3%，主要出现在网绳上，而它们的质量中心差异则小于 1 毫米。 因此，在球拍触地之前，这五次运行实际上是完全相同的。

sents.en: The non-determinism of the solver is real but minute.
sents.zh: 求解器的非确定性是真实存在的，但非常微小。

sents.en: After the first simulation step the five runs differ by at most 0.02 0.02 mm, two hundred-thousandths of the object size.
sents.zh: 在第一步模拟之后，五次运行的差异最多为 0.02 毫米，即物体尺寸的二十万分之二。

sents.en: Before the racket reaches the ground, the runs still differ by at most 3 % 3\% of the object size, mostly in the strings of the net, and their centres of mass by less than 1 1 mm.
sents.zh: 在球拍触地之前，各次运行的差异仍然最多为物体尺寸的 3%，主要出现在网绳上，而它们的质量中心差异则小于 1 毫米。

sents.en: Until the racket reaches the ground, the five runs are therefore practically identical.
sents.zh: 因此，在球拍触地之前，这五次运行实际上是完全相同的。

paragraphs.en: The behavior changes qualitatively at impact. After the racket hits the ground, the runs diverge rapidly and settle into visibly different poses (Fig. 7 ). Over the ten pairs of runs, the final divergence ranges from 10 % 10\% to 51 % 51\% of the object size, with a median of 21 % 21\% . The same vertex can land up to 442 442 mm apart in two runs.
paragraphs.zh: 撞击时，行为发生质的变化。 球拍击中地面后，运行轨迹迅速发散，并稳定为明显不同的姿态（图 7）。 在十对运行中，最终差异范围从物体尺寸的 10% 到 51%，中位数为 21%。 同一顶点在两次运行中的落点间距最大可达 442 毫米。

sents.en: The behavior changes qualitatively at impact.
sents.zh: 撞击时，行为发生质的变化。

sents.en: After the racket hits the ground, the runs diverge rapidly and settle into visibly different poses (Fig. 7 ).
sents.zh: 球拍击中地面后，运行轨迹迅速发散，并稳定为明显不同的姿态（图 7）。

sents.en: Over the ten pairs of runs, the final divergence ranges from 10 % 10\% to 51 % 51\% of the object size, with a median of 21 % 21\% .
sents.zh: 在十对运行中，最终差异范围从物体尺寸的 10% 到 51%，中位数为 21%。

sents.en: The same vertex can land up to 442 442 mm apart in two runs.
sents.zh: 同一顶点在两次运行中的落点间距最大可达 442 毫米。

paragraphs.en: To check that this is chaos and not a peculiarity of the reduction order, we replace the rounding noise by a controlled perturbation: a deterministic initial rotation of the racket between 10 − 8 10^{-8} and 10 − 2 10^{-2} rad. The final divergence is of the same order for every magnitude and does not grow with it. A perturbation a million times larger does not produce a larger difference. This is the signature of chaotic dynamics. The racket has several possible resting poses. Even the smallest perturbation is already enough to change which one it ends in, so making the perturbation larger does not make the difference larger. It only changes which resting pose the racket lands in.
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证这是混沌现象，而非归约顺序的特殊性，我们将四舍五入噪声替换为受控扰动：即球拍在初始阶段进行确定性旋转，旋转角度介于 10^{-8} 和 10^{-2} 弧度之间。 最终的发散量在各个数量级上均处于同一阶次，且不会随数量级的增大而增长。 即使将扰动放大一百万倍，也不会产生更大的差异。 这正是混沌动力学的典型特征。 球拍存在多种可能的静止姿态。 即便是最小的扰动也足以改变其最终所处的静止姿态，因此增大扰动并不会使差异变大。 它只会改变球拍最终落入的静止姿态。

sents.en: To check that this is chaos and not a peculiarity of the reduction order, we replace the rounding noise by a controlled perturbation: a deterministic initial rotation of the racket between 10 − 8 10^{-8} and 10 − 2 10^{-2} rad.
sents.zh: 为了验证这是混沌现象，而非归约顺序的特殊性，我们将四舍五入噪声替换为受控扰动：即球拍在初始阶段进行确定性旋转，旋转角度介于 10^{-8} 和 10^{-2} 弧度之间。

sents.en: The final divergence is of the same order for every magnitude and does not grow with it.
sents.zh: 最终的发散量在各个数量级上均处于同一阶次，且不会随数量级的增大而增长。

sents.en: A perturbation a million times larger does not produce a larger difference.
sents.zh: 即使将扰动放大一百万倍，也不会产生更大的差异。

sents.en: This is the signature of chaotic dynamics.
sents.zh: 这正是混沌动力学的典型特征。

sents.en: The racket has several possible resting poses.
sents.zh: 球拍存在多种可能的静止姿态。

sents.en: Even the smallest perturbation is already enough to change which one it ends in, so making the perturbation larger does not make the difference larger.
sents.zh: 即便是最小的扰动也足以改变其最终所处的静止姿态，因此增大扰动并不会使差异变大。

sents.en: It only changes which resting pose the racket lands in.
sents.zh: 它只会改变球拍最终落入的静止姿态。

paragraphs.en: The sensitivity comes from complex dynamics involving contact. When the racket hits the ground, the solver makes a discrete decision about which edge or corner touches first, and a microscopic perturbation can flip this decision. From then on the bounce and the final pose follow different paths. In our experiments, soft objects that are thin, branchy, or non-convex are more prone to amplifying this chaotic effect.
paragraphs.zh: 这种敏感性源于涉及接触的复杂动态过程。 当球拍击中地面时，求解器会做出一个离散决策，决定哪个边缘或角落先接触，而微小的扰动就可能改变这一决策。 从那时起，弹跳和最终姿态将沿着不同的路径发展。 在我们的实验中，那些较薄、分枝或非凸的软体更容易放大这种混沌效应。

sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，那些较薄、分枝或非凸的软体更容易放大这种混沌效应。

paragraphs.en: The racket above is a single scene. To measure how often two runs of the solver diverge, we run the GPU solver a second time from byte-identical inputs on all 300 300 Objaverse held-out scenes of Table 1 and compare the two runs. We measure their difference relative to the object size, defined as the diagonal of the bounding box at frame 0 0 . Table 5 counts the scenes whose difference exceeds 1 % 1\% , 5 % 5\% , and 10 % 10\% of the object size, using either the mean per-vertex error over the whole trajectory or the per-vertex error at the last frame.
paragraphs.zh: 上面的视频片段是一个单一场景。 为了衡量求解器两次运行出现分歧的频率，我们对表 1 中所有 300×300 个预留的 Objaverse 场景，使用字节完全相同的输入再次运行 GPU 求解器，并比较这两次运行的结果。 我们将它们的差异与物体大小进行比较，后者定义为第 0 帧时边界框的对角线长度。 表 5 统计了差异超过物体大小 1%、5% 和 10% 的场景数量，计算时分别使用了整个轨迹的平均每顶点误差或最后一帧时的每顶点误差。

sents.en: To measure how often two runs of the solver diverge, we run the GPU solver a second time from byte-identical inputs on all 300 300 Objaverse held-out scenes of Table 1 and compare the two runs.
