sents.zh: 表 5 统计了差异超过物体大小 1%、5% 和 10% 的场景数量，计算时分别使用了整个轨迹的平均每顶点误差或最后一帧时的每顶点误差。

paragraphs.en: Most scenes are reproduced closely. The median difference between the two runs is 0.5 0.5 mm over the trajectory and 1.0 1.0 mm at the last frame. A substantial minority of scenes, however, diverge. At the last frame, about a quarter of the scenes end more than 1 % 1\% of the object size apart, and the most divergent scene ends 35 % 35\% apart. In all of these scenes, the two runs agree to sub-millimeter precision until ground contact and separate afterwards, as in the racket example. A difference of 1 % 1\% of the object size means that the two runs end more than 1 1 cm apart on a meter-scale object, which is already a large error for high-precision physical simulation. A regression model can only learn the mean of such diverging outcomes, so high precision is difficult to reach on these scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数场景都得到了高度精确的再现。 两次运行之间的差异中位数在轨迹上为 0.5 0.5 毫米，在最后一帧则为 1.0 1.0 毫米。 然而，相当一部分场景出现了偏离。 在最后一帧，大约四分之一的场景最终以超过物体尺寸 1 % 1\% 的差距结束，而偏离最严重的场景最终差距达到了 35 % 35\%。 在所有这些场景中，两次运行在地面接触前都保持亚毫米级的精度一致，之后则像球拍示例一样出现分离。 物体尺寸 1 % 1\% 的差异意味着，在一米量级的物体上，两次运行的最终位置差距会超过 1 1 厘米，这对于高精度物理模拟来说已经是一个较大的误差。 回归模型只能学习这类偏离结果的平均值，因此在这些场景上难以达到高精度。

sents.zh: 大多数场景都得到了高度精确的再现。

paragraphs.en: In a chaotic scene, the same initial state can lead to several different outcomes. A regression model gives one prediction per initial state, while a diffusion model can draw several. This section tests whether, on chaotic scenes, the samples of the LDM actually cover the different outcomes that the solver produces. We split the 300 300 held-out scenes of Table 5 by how far the two solver runs end apart: 71 71 chaotic scenes, whose runs end more than 1 % 1\% of the object size apart, and 229 229 non-chaotic scenes. For every scene we draw eight samples from the LDM and report two numbers: the error of a single sample, and the error of the best of the eight samples. Choosing the best sample needs the ground truth, so the best-of-eight result is an upper bound on sample selection, not a usable predictor. All other settings follow Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 在混沌场景中，相同的初始状态可能导致多种不同的结果。 回归模型对每个初始状态给出一个预测，而扩散模型可以生成多个预测。 本节检验在混沌场景中，LDM 的样本是否确实覆盖了求解器生成的不同结果。 我们将表 5 中保留的 300×300 个场景，根据两个求解器运行结果的最终差异进行划分：71×71 个混沌场景（其运行结果的差异超过物体尺寸的 1%），以及 229×229 个非混沌场景。 对于每个场景，我们从 LDM 中抽取八个样本，并报告两个数值：单个样本的误差，以及八个样本中最佳样本的误差。 选择最佳样本需要真实值，因此“八选最佳”的结果是样本选择的理论上限，而非可用的预测模型。 所有其他设置均遵循表 2。

sents.en: In a chaotic scene, the same initial state can lead to several different outcomes.
sents.zh: 在混沌场景中，相同的初始状态可能导致多种不同的结果。

sents.en: A regression model gives one prediction per initial state, while a diffusion model can draw several.
sents.zh: 回归模型对每个初始状态给出一个预测，而扩散模型可以生成多个预测。

sents.en: This section tests whether, on chaotic scenes, the samples of the LDM actually cover the different outcomes that the solver produces.
sents.zh: 本节检验在混沌场景中，LDM 的样本是否确实覆盖了求解器生成的不同结果。

sents.en: We split the 300 300 held-out scenes of Table 5 by how far the two solver runs end apart: 71 71 chaotic scenes, whose runs end more than 1 % 1\% of the object size apart, and 229 229 non-chaotic scenes.
sents.zh: 我们将表 5 中保留的 300×300 个场景，根据两个求解器运行结果的最终差异进行划分：71×71 个混沌场景（其运行结果的差异超过物体尺寸的 1%），以及 229×229 个非混沌场景。

sents.en: For every scene we draw eight samples from the LDM and report two numbers: the error of a single sample, and the error of the best of the eight samples.
sents.zh: 对于每个场景，我们从 LDM 中抽取八个样本，并报告两个数值：单个样本的误差，以及八个样本中最佳样本的误差。

sents.en: Choosing the best sample needs the ground truth, so the best-of-eight result is an upper bound on sample selection, not a usable predictor.
sents.zh: 选择最佳样本需要真实值，因此“八选最佳”的结果是样本选择的理论上限，而非可用的预测模型。

sents.en: All other settings follow Table 2 .
sents.zh: 所有其他设置均遵循表 2。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion outperforms regression on both subsets. Table 6 shows that a single diffusion sample already improves on the regression model in every metric, on both subsets. It has a lower error than the regression model in 79 % 79\% of the non-chaotic scenes and 65 % 65\% of the chaotic scenes. The advantage of diffusion is therefore not limited to chaotic scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 在两个子集上，扩散模型的表现均优于回归模型。 表 6 显示，在两个子集上，仅使用一个扩散样本即可在所有指标上超越回归模型。 在非混沌场景中，其错误率低于回归模型的 79%（79\%）；在混沌场景中，则低于 65%（65\%）。 因此，扩散模型的优势并不仅限于混沌场景。

sents.en: Diffusion outperforms regression on both subsets.
sents.zh: 在两个子集上，扩散模型的表现均优于回归模型。

sents.en: Table 6 shows that a single diffusion sample already improves on the regression model in every metric, on both subsets.
sents.zh: 表 6 显示，在两个子集上，仅使用一个扩散样本即可在所有指标上超越回归模型。

sents.en: It has a lower error than the regression model in 79 % 79\% of the non-chaotic scenes and 65 % 65\% of the chaotic scenes.
sents.zh: 在非混沌场景中，其错误率低于回归模型的 79%（79\%）；在混沌场景中，则低于 65%（65\%）。

sents.en: The advantage of diffusion is therefore not limited to chaotic scenes.
sents.zh: 因此，扩散模型的优势并不仅限于混沌场景。

paragraphs.en: Multiple samples matter more under chaos. What differs between the two subsets is how much the eight samples add over a single one. Picking the best of the eight lowers the median error by 3.4 3.4 mm on the non-chaotic scenes and by 9.3 9.3 mm on the chaotic scenes. The samples also spread further apart under chaos: the gap between the best and the worst sample of a scene is 7 7 mm on the non-chaotic scenes and 25 25 mm on the chaotic scenes (medians over scenes). On the chaotic scenes, this spread follows the physics. It grows with the distance between the two solver runs (Spearman ρ = 0.38 \rho=0.38 , p = 0.001 p=0.001 ), and the second solver run lies inside the spread of the eight samples in 99 % 99\% of the scenes. The benefit does not depend on picking the best sample: averaged over the eight samples, the median final-frame error on the chaotic scenes is 138 138 mm, below the 162 162 mm of the regression model. The diffusion model is thus more uncertain where the physics is less predictable, and this uncertainty covers outcomes that the solver itself produces.
paragraphs.zh: 在混沌情况下，多个样本的重要性更高。 这两个子集之间的差异在于，八个样本相比单个样本能带来多大的额外提升。 从八个样本中挑选最佳样本，可将非混沌场景的中位误差降低 3.4 毫米，将混沌场景的中位误差降低 9.3 毫米。 在混沌情况下，样本之间的差异也会更大：同一场景中最佳与最差样本的差距在非混沌场景为 7 毫米，在混沌场景则为 25 毫米（各场景的中位数）。 在混沌场景中，这种差异符合物理规律。 随着两次求解器运行之间的距离增大，这种差异也会扩大（Spearman ρ = 0.38，p = 0.001），并且在 99% 的场景中，第二次求解器运行的结果都落在八个样本的分布范围内。 这种优势并不依赖于挑选最佳样本：对八个样本取平均后，混沌场景的最终帧中位误差为 138 毫米，低于回归模型的 162 毫米。 因此，在物理规律较难预测的区域，扩散模型的不确定性更高，而这种不确定性也涵盖了求解器本身产生的结果。

sents.en: Multiple samples matter more under chaos.
sents.zh: 在混沌情况下，多个样本的重要性更高。

sents.en: What differs between the two subsets is how much the eight samples add over a single one.
sents.zh: 这两个子集之间的差异在于，八个样本相比单个样本能带来多大的额外提升。

sents.en: Picking the best of the eight lowers the median error by 3.4 3.4 mm on the non-chaotic scenes and by 9.3 9.3 mm on the chaotic scenes.
sents.zh: 从八个样本中挑选最佳样本，可将非混沌场景的中位误差降低 3.4 毫米，将混沌场景的中位误差降低 9.3 毫米。

sents.zh: 在混沌场景中，这种差异符合物理规律。

sents.en: It grows with the distance between the two solver runs (Spearman ρ = 0.38 \rho=0.38 , p = 0.001 p=0.001 ), and the second solver run lies inside the spread of the eight samples in 99 % 99\% of the scenes.
sents.zh: 随着两次求解器运行之间的距离增大，这种差异也会扩大（Spearman ρ = 0.38，p = 0.001），并且在 99% 的场景中，第二次求解器运行的结果都落在八个样本的分布范围内。

sents.en: The benefit does not depend on picking the best sample: averaged over the eight samples, the median final-frame error on the chaotic scenes is 138 138 mm, below the 162 162 mm of the regression model.
sents.zh: 这种优势并不依赖于挑选最佳样本：对八个样本取平均后，混沌场景的最终帧中位误差为 138 毫米，低于回归模型的 162 毫米。

sents.en: The diffusion model is thus more uncertain where the physics is less predictable, and this uncertainty covers outcomes that the solver itself produces.
sents.zh: 因此，在物理规律较难预测的区域，扩散模型的不确定性更高，而这种不确定性也涵盖了求解器本身产生的结果。

paragraphs.en: An example: a falling soft key. In a scene with several possible outcomes, diffusion can learn these outcomes, whereas regression can only learn a non-physical average that matches none of them. Fig. 8 shows such a scene, a soft key. When the solver is run twice, the key falls over in two different directions. The regression model predicts a single pose that lies between the two runs and resembles neither. The eight diffusion samples instead fall on both sides, and the closest of them come close to each of the two runs. Other scenes behave similarly. Among the six scenes whose two runs end more than 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} apart, at least one diffusion sample ends within 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} of a solver run in five scenes, while the regression model does so in only one.
paragraphs.zh: 一个例子：一个正在下落的软键。 在一个存在多种可能结果的场景中，扩散模型能够学习这些结果，而回归模型只能学习到一个非物理的平均值，这个平均值与任何实际结果都不匹配。 图 8 展示了这样一个场景：一个软键。 当求解器运行两次时，该键会朝两个不同的方向倒下。 回归模型预测出的单一姿态位于两次运行结果之间，但与两者都不相似。 相反，八个扩散样本则分布在两侧，其中与两次运行结果最接近的样本分别接近于其中一个运行结果。 其他场景的表现也类似。 在六个其两次运行结果相差超过 30° 的场景中，至少有五个场景的扩散样本中至少有一个落在了求解器运行结果的 30° 范围内，而回归模型仅在其中一个场景中做到了这一点。

sents.zh: 图 8 展示了这样一个场景：一个软键。

sents.en: When the solver is run twice, the key falls over in two different directions.
sents.zh: 当求解器运行两次时，该键会朝两个不同的方向倒下。

sents.en: The regression model predicts a single pose that lies between the two runs and resembles neither.
sents.zh: 回归模型预测出的单一姿态位于两次运行结果之间，但与两者都不相似。

sents.en: The eight diffusion samples instead fall on both sides, and the closest of them come close to each of the two runs.
sents.zh: 相反，八个扩散样本则分布在两侧，其中与两次运行结果最接近的样本分别接近于其中一个运行结果。

sents.en: Among the six scenes whose two runs end more than 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} apart, at least one diffusion sample ends within 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} of a solver run in five scenes, while the regression model does so in only one.
sents.zh: 在六个其两次运行结果相差超过 30° 的场景中，至少有五个场景的扩散样本中至少有一个落在了求解器运行结果的 30° 范围内，而回归模型仅在其中一个场景中做到了这一点。

paragraphs.en: An advantage of the paradigm, not of a stronger model. One may worry that the diffusion model is simply the stronger model (the LDM uses 50 50 sampling steps, the regression model a single pass), and that the results above reflect this difference. Three observations show that on chaotic scenes the advantage comes from the paradigm. First, the diffusion samples differ from each other in a way that follows the physics: their spread grows with the distance between the two solver runs and contains the second run in 99 % 99\% of the chaotic scenes. A deterministic model, however strong, gives a single prediction per initial state and has no such spread. Second, where the solver itself produces clearly different outcomes, the diffusion samples reach them, while the regression prediction is a non-physical average between them, as in the key example. Third, the benefit of drawing several samples depends on the scenes, not on the model. With the same model on both subsets, it is almost three times larger on the chaotic scenes ( 9.3 9.3 against 3.4 3.4 mm), whereas a difference in model strength would affect both subsets alike.
paragraphs.zh: 这是该范式的优势，而非更强模型的优势。 有人可能会担心，扩散模型其实只是更强的模型（LDM 使用了 50 个采样步骤，而回归模型仅使用一次遍历），并且上述结果反映了这种差异。 以下三点观察表明，在混沌场景中，这种优势源于该范式本身。 首先，扩散样本彼此之间的差异遵循物理规律：它们的分布范围随着两个求解器运行之间的距离增大而扩大，并且在 99% 的混沌场景中都包含了第二次运行的结果。 然而，无论一个确定性模型有多强，它对每个初始状态都只会给出单一预测，不存在这种分布范围。 其次，当求解器本身产生明显不同的结果时，扩散样本能够达成这些结果，而回归预测则是两者之间的一种非物理的平均值，如关键示例所示。 第三，抽取多个样本所带来的益处取决于具体场景，而非模型本身。 在两个子集上使用同一模型时，混沌场景中的优势几乎大出三倍（9.3 毫米对比 3.4 毫米），而如果模型强度存在差异，则两个子集都会受到同等影响。

sents.en: An advantage of the paradigm, not of a stronger model.
sents.zh: 这是该范式的优势，而非更强模型的优势。

sents.en: One may worry that the diffusion model is simply the stronger model (the LDM uses 50 50 sampling steps, the regression model a single pass), and that the results above reflect this difference.
sents.zh: 有人可能会担心，扩散模型其实只是更强的模型（LDM 使用了 50 个采样步骤，而回归模型仅使用一次遍历），并且上述结果反映了这种差异。

sents.zh: 以下三点观察表明，在混沌场景中，这种优势源于该范式本身。

sents.en: First, the diffusion samples differ from each other in a way that follows the physics: their spread grows with the distance between the two solver runs and contains the second run in 99 % 99\% of the chaotic scenes.
sents.zh: 首先，扩散样本彼此之间的差异遵循物理规律：它们的分布范围随着两个求解器运行之间的距离增大而扩大，并且在 99% 的混沌场景中都包含了第二次运行的结果。

sents.en: A deterministic model, however strong, gives a single prediction per initial state and has no such spread.
sents.zh: 然而，无论一个确定性模型有多强，它对每个初始状态都只会给出单一预测，不存在这种分布范围。

sents.en: Second, where the solver itself produces clearly different outcomes, the diffusion samples reach them, while the regression prediction is a non-physical average between them, as in the key example.
sents.zh: 其次，当求解器本身产生明显不同的结果时，扩散样本能够达成这些结果，而回归预测则是两者之间的一种非物理的平均值，如关键示例所示。

sents.en: Third, the benefit of drawing several samples depends on the scenes, not on the model.
sents.zh: 第三，抽取多个样本所带来的益处取决于具体场景，而非模型本身。

sents.en: With the same model on both subsets, it is almost three times larger on the chaotic scenes ( 9.3 9.3 against 3.4 3.4 mm), whereas a difference in model strength would affect both subsets alike.
sents.zh: 在两个子集上使用同一模型时，混沌场景中的优势几乎大出三倍（9.3 毫米对比 3.4 毫米），而如果模型强度存在差异，则两个子集都会受到同等影响。

paragraphs.en: In summary, diffusion predicts more accurately than regression on both chaotic and non-chaotic scenes. On chaotic scenes it also produces several plausible outcomes, while regression gives a single non-physical average result. These results show that diffusion is better suited to chaotic deformable dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，在混沌和非混沌场景下，扩散模型都比回归模型能更准确地做出预测。 在混沌场景中，它还能生成几种合理的结果，而回归模型则只给出一个非物理的平均结果。 这些结果表明，扩散模型更适合处理混沌的可变形动力学问题。

sents.zh: 总而言之，在混沌和非混沌场景下，扩散模型都比回归模型能更准确地做出预测。

sents.zh: 在混沌场景中，它还能生成几种合理的结果，而回归模型则只给出一个非物理的平均结果。

sents.en: These results show that diffusion is better suited to chaotic deformable dynamics.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，扩散模型更适合处理混沌的可变形动力学问题。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the baselines of Table 1 and Table 2 , and reports the full reconstruction and prediction results (Tables 7 and 8 ). The reconstruction baselines are alternative learned representations of the same trajectories, and the prediction baselines are alternative dynamics models started from the same initial state.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了表 1 和表 2 中的基线方法，并报告了完整的重建与预测结果（表 7 和表 8）。 重建基线是对相同轨迹的不同学习表示，而预测基线则是从相同初始状态启动的不同动力学模型。

sents.en: This section describes the baselines of Table 1 and Table 2 , and reports the full reconstruction and prediction results (Tables 7 and 8 ).
sents.zh: 本节介绍了表 1 和表 2 中的基线方法，并报告了完整的重建与预测结果（表 7 和表 8）。

sents.en: The reconstruction baselines are alternative learned representations of the same trajectories, and the prediction baselines are alternative dynamics models started from the same initial state.
sents.zh: 重建基线是对相同轨迹的不同学习表示，而预测基线则是从相同初始状态启动的不同动力学模型。

paragraphs.en: All reconstruction baselines use the 8 × 8\times temporal compression rate and the T = 32 T{=}32 window of ST-VAE Small, start from the same pretrained spatial VAE (except the direct world-coordinate baseline), and are trained on the same data with comparable budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 所有重建基线方法均使用 8 × 8\times 的时间压缩率以及 ST-VAE Small 的 T = 32 T{=}32 窗口，并从相同的预训练空间 VAE 开始（直接世界坐标基线方法除外），并在相同的数据上以相当的训练资源进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Standard : standard temporal compression of video VAEs. It stacks per-frame latents { 𝐳 t } t = 1 T \{\mathbf{z}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} and shares the factorized spatiotemporal attention of our ST-VAE, but downsamples time by strided convolution to T lat = T / k T_{\mathrm{lat}}=T/k latent frames and reconstructs the full frame rate from this time-ordered sequence of latent frames with a local temporal upsampler.
paragraphs.zh: 标准模式：视频 VAE 的标准时间压缩方法。 该方法将每帧的潜在变量 { 𝐳 t } t = 1 T \{\mathbf{z}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} 堆叠起来，并共享我们 ST-VAE 的因子化时空注意力机制，但通过步长卷积将时间下采样至 T lat = T / k 个潜在帧，再利用局部时间上采样器从这一按时间顺序排列的潜在帧序列中重建完整的帧率。

sents.en: Standard : standard temporal compression of video VAEs.
sents.zh: 标准模式：视频 VAE 的标准时间压缩方法。

sents.en: It stacks per-frame latents { 𝐳 t } t = 1 T \{\mathbf{z}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} and shares the factorized spatiotemporal attention of our ST-VAE, but downsamples time by strided convolution to T lat = T / k T_{\mathrm{lat}}=T/k latent frames and reconstructs the full frame rate from this time-ordered sequence of latent frames with a local temporal upsampler.
sents.zh: 该方法将每帧的潜在变量 { 𝐳 t } t = 1 T \{\mathbf{z}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} 堆叠起来，并共享我们 ST-VAE 的因子化时空注意力机制，但通过步长卷积将时间下采样至 T lat = T / k 个潜在帧，再利用局部时间上采样器从这一按时间顺序排列的潜在帧序列中重建完整的帧率。

paragraphs.en: + velocity loss : the strongest variant of the standard baseline we found. It adds a velocity-matching loss on the consecutive-frame differences of the reconstructed deformation and an unfrozen spatial VAE.
paragraphs.zh: + 速度损失：我们发现的标准基线模型中效果最强的变体。 它在重建形变的连续帧差异以及未冻结的空间 VAE 上增加了一个速度匹配损失。

sents.en: + velocity loss : the strongest variant of the standard baseline we found.
sents.zh: + 速度损失：我们发现的标准基线模型中效果最强的变体。

sents.en: It adds a velocity-matching loss on the consecutive-frame differences of the reconstructed deformation and an unfrozen spatial VAE.
sents.zh: 它在重建形变的连续帧差异以及未冻结的空间 VAE 上增加了一个速度匹配损失。

paragraphs.en: + spectral loss : the standard baseline with an additional loss on the deformation-change curve of Appendix B.3 . The curve is transformed along the time axis with a Fourier transform, and the energy at each frequency is compared with that of the ground-truth curve. Low frequencies correspond to slow changes of the deformation and high frequencies to fast ones, so the loss asks the reconstruction to contain as much fast change as the ground truth instead of smoothing it away. It fails possibly because a frequency spectrum records how much fast change there is but not when it happens, so the standard baseline still cannot place the rapid change at the right instant between two latent frames.
paragraphs.zh: + 光谱损失：标准基线模型，在附录 B.3 的形变变化曲线上增加了一项额外的损失。 该曲线通过傅里叶变换沿时间轴进行转换，然后比较每个频率处的能量与真实曲线中的对应能量。 低频对应于形变的缓慢变化，高频则对应于快速变化，因此该损失要求重建结果包含与真实数据同等程度的快速变化，而不是将其平滑掉。 这种方法可能失败的原因在于，频率谱记录了快速变化的程度，但并未记录其发生的时间，因此标准基线模型仍然无法在两个潜在帧之间将快速变化定位到正确的时刻。

sents.en: + spectral loss : the standard baseline with an additional loss on the deformation-change curve of Appendix B.3 .
sents.zh: + 光谱损失：标准基线模型，在附录 B.3 的形变变化曲线上增加了一项额外的损失。

sents.en: The curve is transformed along the time axis with a Fourier transform, and the energy at each frequency is compared with that of the ground-truth curve.
sents.zh: 该曲线通过傅里叶变换沿时间轴进行转换，然后比较每个频率处的能量与真实曲线中的对应能量。

sents.en: Low frequencies correspond to slow changes of the deformation and high frequencies to fast ones, so the loss asks the reconstruction to contain as much fast change as the ground truth instead of smoothing it away.
sents.zh: 低频对应于形变的缓慢变化，高频则对应于快速变化，因此该损失要求重建结果包含与真实数据同等程度的快速变化，而不是将其平滑掉。

sents.en: It fails possibly because a frequency spectrum records how much fast change there is but not when it happens, so the standard baseline still cannot place the rapid change at the right instant between two latent frames.
sents.zh: 这种方法可能失败的原因在于，频率谱记录了快速变化的程度，但并未记录其发生的时间，因此标准基线模型仍然无法在两个潜在帧之间将快速变化定位到正确的时刻。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive compression : a separate baseline that keeps the number of latent frames of the standard baseline but places them non-uniformly along time according to the temporal curvature of the ground-truth deformation. Its lower DCC in Table 1 may have the following cause. With only M = 4 M{=}4 latent frames per 32 32 -frame window, the impact takes most of them and the rebound and settling frames are left with one or two, so their motion is likely reconstructed flat and released in a late snap.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应压缩：一种独立的基线方法，它保留了标准基线中的潜在帧数量，但根据真实形变的时域曲率，将这些帧非均匀地分布在时间轴上。 表 1 中其 DCC 较低可能有以下原因。 在每 32 帧窗口内仅使用 M = 4 个潜在帧的情况下，大部分帧被用于捕捉主要影响，而反弹和稳定阶段的帧仅剩一两个，因此它们的运动很可能被重建为平缓的，并在后期突然释放。

sents.en: Adaptive compression : a separate baseline that keeps the number of latent frames of the standard baseline but places them non-uniformly along time according to the temporal curvature of the ground-truth deformation.
sents.zh: 自适应压缩：一种独立的基线方法，它保留了标准基线中的潜在帧数量，但根据真实形变的时域曲率，将这些帧非均匀地分布在时间轴上。

sents.en: Its lower DCC in Table 1 may have the following cause.
sents.zh: 表 1 中其 DCC 较低可能有以下原因。

sents.en: With only M = 4 M{=}4 latent frames per 32 32 -frame window, the impact takes most of them and the rebound and settling frames are left with one or two, so their motion is likely reconstructed flat and released in a late snap.
sents.zh: 在每 32 帧窗口内仅使用 M = 4 个潜在帧的情况下，大部分帧被用于捕捉主要影响，而反弹和稳定阶段的帧仅剩一两个，因此它们的运动很可能被重建为平缓的，并在后期突然释放。

paragraphs.en: Direct world-coord. (direct world-coordinate reconstruction): removes the factoring of Eq. ( 1 ). Its spatial VAE is trained on world-coordinate frames without canonicalization, and the same holistic temporal compression is applied on top without a rigid token, so rigid motion and deformation share one latent.
paragraphs.zh: 直接世界坐标。 （直接世界坐标重建）：消除了方程（1）中的分解步骤。 其空间 VAE 是在未经规范化的世界坐标帧上进行训练的，并在其基础上应用了相同的整体时间压缩，但没有使用刚性标记，因此刚性运动和形变共享一个潜在变量。

sents.en: Direct world-coord.
sents.zh: 直接世界坐标。

sents.en: (direct world-coordinate reconstruction): removes the factoring of Eq. ( 1 ).
sents.zh: （直接世界坐标重建）：消除了方程（1）中的分解步骤。

sents.en: Its spatial VAE is trained on world-coordinate frames without canonicalization, and the same holistic temporal compression is applied on top without a rigid token, so rigid motion and deformation share one latent.
sents.zh: 其空间 VAE 是在未经规范化的世界坐标帧上进行训练的，并在其基础上应用了相同的整体时间压缩，但没有使用刚性标记，因此刚性运动和形变共享一个潜在变量。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 reports the full ST-VAE reconstruction comparison with all six ST-VAEs, including the two variants of the standard baseline and the adaptive-compression baseline, which are omitted from Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 报告了与全部六个 ST-VAE 的完整 ST-VAE 重建对比，其中包括标准基线和自适应压缩基线的两个变体，这些变体在表 1 中未予列出。

paragraphs.en: The prediction baselines receive the same initial state as PhysLDM.
paragraphs.zh: 预测基线接收与 PhysLDM 相同的初始状态。

paragraphs.en: Regression : a deterministic regression model that is capacity-matched to the LDM and shares its ST-VAE and conditioning. It is a transformer that emits the full latent trajectory in one pass and is trained with the token-weighted mean-squared error of Appendix A , so that only the predictive paradigm differs between the two.
paragraphs.zh: 回归：一种确定性回归模型，其容量与 LDM 相匹配，并共享其 ST-VAE 和条件信息。 它是一种变压器模型，能单次处理输出完整的潜在轨迹，并使用附录 A 中的基于词符权重的均方误差进行训练，因此两者之间仅预测范式存在差异。

sents.en: Regression : a deterministic regression model that is capacity-matched to the LDM and shares its ST-VAE and conditioning.
sents.zh: 回归：一种确定性回归模型，其容量与 LDM 相匹配，并共享其 ST-VAE 和条件信息。

sents.en: It is a transformer that emits the full latent trajectory in one pass and is trained with the token-weighted mean-squared error of Appendix A , so that only the predictive paradigm differs between the two.
sents.zh: 它是一种变压器模型，能单次处理输出完整的潜在轨迹，并使用附录 A 中的基于词符权重的均方误差进行训练，因此两者之间仅预测范式存在差异。

paragraphs.en: MGN-style AR (MeshGraphNets-style autoregressive model): a graph network ( Pfaff et al., 2021 ) over the tetrahedral mesh graph that predicts one frame at a time from the previous frames, with the noise-injected one-step training standard in that family ( Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ) , retrained on our scenes. Predicting world coordinates step by step, it accumulates error over time and drifts far from the ground truth (Table 2 ). It is compared with our model under a fair setting.
paragraphs.zh: MGN 风格 AR（MeshGraphNets 风格自回归模型）：一种基于四面体网格图的图网络（Pfaff 等人，2021），它根据前几帧逐帧预测下一帧，并采用该类别中注入噪声的单步训练标准（Sanchez-Gonzalez 等人，2020），并在我们的场景上重新训练。 由于它是逐步预测世界坐标的，因此会随时间累积误差，并逐渐偏离真实值（表 2）。 在公平的设置下，它与我们的模型进行了比较。

sents.zh: 在公平的设置下，它与我们的模型进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 reports the prediction comparison with all six physics checks, including the velocity and acceleration violation rates that are omitted from Table 2 , together with the ST-VAE reconstruction of the ground truth as a reference row, which gives the autoencoder’s own contribution to each metric.
paragraphs.zh: 表8报告了与全部六个物理检查的预测对比，其中包括在表2中未列出的速度和加速度违反率，同时还将ST-VAE对真实值的重建结果作为参考行列出，以显示自编码器对每个指标本身的贡献。

paragraphs.en: This section collects the ablations that support design choices of the model: the use of the ST-VAE, the dedicated rigid pathway, the spatial-VAE pretraining, and the decoder GNN.
paragraphs.zh: 本节汇总了支持模型设计决策的消融实验结果：包括使用 ST-VAE、专用刚性路径、空间 VAE 预训练以及解码器 GNN。

paragraphs.en: This section gives the measurements behind the ST-VAE ablation of Sec. 4.1 , which asks what happens to the training cost when the ST-VAE is removed and the LDM denoises the raw vertex × \times frame tokens directly. We compare two options on the same GPU at increasing vertex counts N N . The first is our LDM architecture applied to the raw tokens, without any latent. The second is our pipeline with the ST-VAE, where the LDM works on a fixed set of 4,104 4{,}104 latent tokens and the ST-VAE is the stage with the largest memory footprint. Table 9 lists the peak training memory of both.
paragraphs.zh: 本节给出了第 4.1 节中 ST-VAE 消融实验的测量结果，该实验旨在探究当移除 ST-VAE 并由 LDM 直接对原始顶点 × \times 帧令牌进行去噪时，训练成本会发生怎样的变化。 我们在相同的 GPU 上，针对不断增长的顶点数量 N N ，比较了两种方案。 第一种方案是将我们的 LDM 架构直接应用于原始令牌，且不使用任何潜在变量。 第二种方案是包含 ST-VAE 的我们的处理流程，其中 LDM 作用于一个固定的 4,104 4{,}104 个潜在令牌集合，而 ST-VAE 是内存占用最大的阶段。 表 9 列出了这两种方案的峰值训练内存。

sents.zh: 第一种方案是将我们的 LDM 架构直接应用于原始令牌，且不使用任何潜在变量。

sents.en: The second is our pipeline with the ST-VAE, where the LDM works on a fixed set of 4,104 4{,}104 latent tokens and the ST-VAE is the stage with the largest memory footprint.
sents.zh: 第二种方案是包含 ST-VAE 的我们的处理流程，其中 LDM 作用于一个固定的 4,104 4{,}104 个潜在令牌集合，而 ST-VAE 是内存占用最大的阶段。

sents.en: Table 9 lists the peak training memory of both.
sents.zh: 表 9 列出了这两种方案的峰值训练内存。

paragraphs.en: Without the ST-VAE the number of tokens is T × N T\times N , so memory grows with N N . The raw-token model fits at batch 1 1 up to 2,500 2{,}500 vertices and runs out of memory at 2,600 2{,}600 , below the median resolution of our dataset ( ∼ 3,400 {\sim}3{,}400 vertices). More than half of the training scenes therefore cannot be processed at all. With the ST-VAE, the LDM costs about 4.4 4.4 GiB per trajectory at any N N . The ST-VAE stage grows linearly with N N , by about 8 8 GiB per 1,000 1{,}000 vertices, and ST-VAE Base trains up to about 14,000 14{,}000 vertices on the same card. The latent therefore does not remove the vertex-dependent cost, but moves it to a stage that scales far more gently.

paragraphs.en: Sec. 4.1 shows that routing the rigid token through the shared holistic temporal compression makes the translation error explode and starves the deformation track: on a small held-out diagnostic set, the translation error grows from 1.8 1.8 to 887 887 mm, and the reconstructed deformation shrinks to 28 % 28\% of its true magnitude ( 97 % 97\% with the dedicated pathway). In addition, the failure is not a matter of numerical scale. Normalizing the rigid signal to unit variance before the shared compression barely helps ( → 49.6 52.8\!\rightarrow\!49.6 mm world error), whereas the dedicated linear pathway reaches 8.3 8.3 mm. The rigid and the deformation signals compete for the capacity of the shared latent, and the dedicated pathway removes this competition.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.1 节表明，将刚性标记通过共享的整体时间压缩进行路由会导致翻译误差急剧上升，并使形变追踪资源匮乏：在一个小型预留的诊断数据集上，翻译误差从 1.8 mm 增长到 887 mm，而重建的形变则缩小到其真实幅度的 28%（若使用专用通路则为 97%）。 此外，这种失败并非数值量级的问题。 在共享压缩之前将刚性信号归一化为单位方差几乎无济于事（→ 世界误差为 49.6 mm），而专用线性通路则能达到 8.3 mm。 刚性信号和形变信号会争夺共享潜在空间的容量，而专用通路则消除了这种竞争。

paragraphs.en: This section explains why the spatial VAE needs to be pretrained first rather than trained directly together with the ST-VAE. We compare two training schemes at a matched budget. The first pretrains the spatial VAE and then trains the ST-VAE on top of it with an additional latent-anchor loss (Sec. 3.3 ), which ties the per-frame latents reconstructed by the ST-VAE to those of the pretrained spatial VAE. The second trains both stages jointly from scratch, with a randomly initialized spatial VAE.
paragraphs.zh: 本节将解释为何需要首先对空间 VAE 进行预训练，而不是直接将其与 ST-VAE 一同训练。 我们在预算匹配的情况下比较了两种训练方案。 第一种方案先对空间 VAE 进行预训练，然后在此基础上使用额外的潜在锚点损失（第 3.3 节）训练 ST-VAE，从而将 ST-VAE 重建的每帧潜在变量与预训练的空间 VAE 的潜在变量关联起来。 第二种方案则从初始状态开始联合训练两个阶段，其中空间 VAE 是随机初始化的。

sents.en: This section explains why the spatial VAE needs to be pretrained first rather than trained directly together with the ST-VAE.
sents.zh: 本节将解释为何需要首先对空间 VAE 进行预训练，而不是直接将其与 ST-VAE 一同训练。

sents.en: We compare two training schemes at a matched budget.
sents.zh: 我们在预算匹配的情况下比较了两种训练方案。

sents.en: The first pretrains the spatial VAE and then trains the ST-VAE on top of it with an additional latent-anchor loss (Sec. 3.3 ), which ties the per-frame latents reconstructed by the ST-VAE to those of the pretrained spatial VAE.
sents.zh: 第一种方案先对空间 VAE 进行预训练，然后在此基础上使用额外的潜在锚点损失（第 3.3 节）训练 ST-VAE，从而将 ST-VAE 重建的每帧潜在变量与预训练的空间 VAE 的潜在变量关联起来。

sents.en: The second trains both stages jointly from scratch, with a randomly initialized spatial VAE.
sents.zh: 第二种方案则从初始状态开始联合训练两个阶段，其中空间 VAE 是随机初始化的。

paragraphs.en: We find that joint training works poorly. At the standard learning rate, training diverges within a few thousand steps. At a reduced learning rate, it converges to a much worse model: the geometric reconstruction error is about 5 × 5\times that of the pretrained scheme, the deformation is much weaker than the ground truth, and volume is lost. The likely reason is that the two stages chase each other. The latent that the ST-VAE learns to reproduce keeps moving while the spatial VAE is still changing, so the temporal model has no fixed target. Pretraining fixes the target first. Once pretrained, the spatial VAE can either be kept frozen during ST-VAE training or fine-tuned with a smaller learning rate, and the two options give similar results. We keep it frozen for ST-VAE Small and fine-tune it for ST-VAE Base.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现联合训练效果不佳。 在标准学习率下，训练会在数千步内发散。 在降低学习率后，模型会收敛到一个质量差得多的版本：几何重建误差约为预训练方案的 5 × 5\times 倍，形变远弱于真实数据，且体积有所损失。 可能的原因是两个阶段相互追逐。 ST-VAE 学会复现的潜在变量在空间 VAE 仍在变化时持续移动，因此时间模型没有固定的目标。 预训练首先会固定这个目标。 完成预训练后，在 ST-VAE 训练期间，空间 VAE 既可以保持冻结状态，也可以用较小的学习率进行微调，这两种选择得到的结果相似。 对于 ST-VAE Small，我们将其保持冻结；对于 ST-VAE Base，则对其进行微调。

sents.en: We find that joint training works poorly.
sents.zh: 我们发现联合训练效果不佳。

sents.en: At the standard learning rate, training diverges within a few thousand steps.
sents.zh: 在标准学习率下，训练会在数千步内发散。

sents.en: At a reduced learning rate, it converges to a much worse model: the geometric reconstruction error is about 5 × 5\times that of the pretrained scheme, the deformation is much weaker than the ground truth, and volume is lost.
sents.zh: 在降低学习率后，模型会收敛到一个质量差得多的版本：几何重建误差约为预训练方案的 5 × 5\times 倍，形变远弱于真实数据，且体积有所损失。

sents.zh: 可能的原因是两个阶段相互追逐。

sents.en: The latent that the ST-VAE learns to reproduce keeps moving while the spatial VAE is still changing, so the temporal model has no fixed target.
sents.zh: ST-VAE 学会复现的潜在变量在空间 VAE 仍在变化时持续移动，因此时间模型没有固定的目标。

sents.en: Pretraining fixes the target first.
sents.zh: 预训练首先会固定这个目标。

sents.zh: 完成预训练后，在 ST-VAE 训练期间，空间 VAE 既可以保持冻结状态，也可以用较小的学习率进行微调，这两种选择得到的结果相似。

sents.en: We keep it frozen for ST-VAE Small and fine-tune it for ST-VAE Base.
sents.zh: 对于 ST-VAE Small，我们将其保持冻结；对于 ST-VAE Base，则对其进行微调。

paragraphs.en: We use a GNN component in the spatial VAE decoder because the field decoder places every vertex independently, so nothing ties neighboring vertices together, and the GNN over the tetrahedral mesh adds this coupling. We compare three placements of the GNN: in the decoder, as in our model; removed; and moved to the encoder instead. Without the GNN, reconstruction degrades and many mesh edges end up stretched far from their rest length. With the GNN in the encoder, the result is worse on every metric, because smoothing the mesh before encoding removes detail before it reaches the latent, whereas smoothing after decoding only regularizes the output.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在空间 VAE 解码器中使用了 GNN 组件，因为场解码器是独立放置每个顶点的，因此没有任何机制能将相邻顶点连接起来，而基于四面体网格的 GNN 则引入了这种耦合。 我们比较了三种 GNN 的放置方式：像我们的模型一样置于解码器中；移除它；以及将其移至编码器中。 如果没有 GNN，重建效果会下降，许多网格边最终会被拉伸得远离其静止长度。 将 GNN 置于编码器中后，所有指标的结果都更差，因为在编码前对网格进行平滑处理会在细节到达潜在空间之前将其消除，而解码后再进行平滑处理则只会对输出进行正则化。

sents.zh: 如果没有 GNN，重建效果会下降，许多网格边最终会被拉伸得远离其静止长度。

sents.en: With the GNN in the encoder, the result is worse on every metric, because smoothing the mesh before encoding removes detail before it reaches the latent, whereas smoothing after decoding only regularizes the output.
sents.zh: 将 GNN 置于编码器中后，所有指标的结果都更差，因为在编码前对网格进行平滑处理会在细节到达潜在空间之前将其消除，而解码后再进行平滑处理则只会对输出进行正则化。

paragraphs.en: This section reports the inference speed of PhysLDM and how it depends on the mesh resolution. We measure batch-1 inference on a single H200 for 64 64 -frame trajectories on five held-out scenes with 980 980 to 9,851 9{,}851 vertices, the last three beyond the 5,000 5{,}000 -vertex training cap. One inference pass consists of three steps: the spatial VAE encodes frame 0 0 , the latent model predicts the latent trajectory (one forward pass for the regression model, 50 50 or 20 20 Euler steps for the LDM), and the ST-VAE decodes all 64 64 frames. Timings are medians over repeated runs with the GPU synchronized and no I/O in the timed region, in bf16 and in fp32 . Table 10 lists the decoding time, the resulting frame rates, and the peak GPU memory.
paragraphs.zh: 本节报告了 PhysLDM 的推理速度及其对网格分辨率的依赖关系。 我们在单颗 H200 上测量了 batch-1 推理的性能，测试对象为五个预留场景中的 64 帧轨迹，这些场景的顶点数从 980 到 9,851 不等，其中最后三种场景的顶点数超过了 5,000 的训练上限。 一次推理流程包含三个步骤：空间 VAE 对第 0 帧进行编码，潜在模型预测潜在轨迹（回归模型执行一次前向传播，LDM 执行 50 或 20 个欧拉步），最后由 ST-VAE 解码全部 64 帧。 时间测量值是在多次运行中取的中位数，期间 GPU 已同步，且计时区域不包含 I/O 操作，测试环境分别使用 bf16 和 fp32 格式。 表 10 列出了解码时间、由此产生的帧率以及峰值 GPU 显存占用量。

paragraphs.en: Two observations follow. First, the cost of the latent model is independent of the mesh resolution, because it always works on the same 4,104 4{,}104 latent tokens, so its latency is the same at every N N ( bf16 : 9.8 9.8 ms for the regression model, 460 460 ms for the LDM at 20 20 steps, and 1,150 1{,}150 ms at 50 50 ). The decoder is the only stage whose cost grows with N N , and in bf16 it is nearly flat, from 318 318 ms at 980 980 vertices to 384 384 ms at 9,851 9{,}851 , with no loss of accuracy. As a result, the LDM runs at about 40 40 to 80 80 frames per second in bf16 and the regression model at up to 195 195 , even on meshes twice the training cap. Second, the whole pass needs only about 5 5 GiB of GPU memory across the range.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来有两点观察。 首先，潜在模型的成本与网格分辨率无关，因为它始终处理相同的 4,104 个潜在标记，因此其延迟在所有 N 值下都相同（bf16 模式下：回归模型为 9.8 毫秒，LDM 在 20 步时为 460 毫秒，在 50 步时为 1,150 毫秒）。 解码器是唯一成本随 N 增长的阶段，并且在 bf16 模式下其成本几乎保持不变：从 980 个顶点时的 318 毫秒到 9,851 个顶点时的 384 毫秒，且精度没有损失。 因此，在 bf16 模式下，LDM 的运行帧率约为每秒 40 至 80 帧，而回归模型最高可达每秒 195 帧，即使在训练上限两倍的网格上也是如此。 其次，在整个范围内，整个处理过程仅需约 5 GiB 的 GPU 内存。

paragraphs.en: This section extends the qualitative figures of the main text with more scenes, lists the parameters of every scene shown, and presents the extreme case of Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 本节通过增加更多场景，对正文中的定性图示进行了扩展，列出了所有所示场景的参数，并展示了附录 I 中的极端情况。

paragraphs.en: Figs. 9 , 10 , and 11 extend Figs. 3 and 4 with further scenes, rendered and laid out in the same way. Figs. 9 and 10 show ST-VAE reconstruction on four more scenes against every ST-VAE baseline of Table 7 . Fig. 11 shows our prediction on four more scenes against the prediction baselines of Table 2 . The observations of the main text hold on these scenes as well. The results of the standard baseline, its variants, and adaptive compression look reasonable in these static frames, but their DCC values (Table 7 ) show that they have the staircase artifact. The direct world-coordinate baseline produces noisy geometric detail. The regression model produces wrong physics and jitter, and the MGN-style AR baseline drifts over time. Tables 11 and 12 list the source dataset, node count, and simulation parameters of every scene in these figures and in the main-text figures.

Twenty-six objects from GSO, Toys4K, and the held-out Objaverse scenes, with 1,517 1{,}517 to 9,821 9{,}821 nodes, are thrown onto a round stage with initial speeds between 0.57 0.57 and 1.87 1.87 m/s and Young’s moduli between 3 × 10 4 3\times 10^{4} and 3 × 10 6 3\times 10^{6} Pa, so that soft plush toys, a rubber boot, and a bunch of grapes share the scene with a helmet, a drill, and a cardboard box. The inset shows the initial state: every object in its undeformed rest shape, placed above the position where it will land, seen from the same camera as the main view. The main view shows the predicted state near the end of the sequence, when almost all objects have landed, rendered with the original textures of the assets. paragraphs.en: This section analyzes extreme cases. The accuracy of the LDM is fundamentally bounded by the reconstruction performance of the ST-VAE, meaning that the most challenging cases for the ST-VAE set the limits of the entire pipeline. Across the held-out scenes, the largest reconstruction errors mostly occur on geometries with many long, thin features.
paragraphs.zh: 本节分析了极端情况。 LDM 的准确性从根本上受到 ST-VAE 重建性能的限制，这意味着 ST-VAE 最具挑战性的情况决定了整个流程的极限。 在所有预留的场景中，最大的重建误差主要出现在具有许多细长特征的几何结构上。

sents.en: This section analyzes extreme cases.
sents.zh: 本节分析了极端情况。

sents.en: The accuracy of the LDM is fundamentally bounded by the reconstruction performance of the ST-VAE, meaning that the most challenging cases for the ST-VAE set the limits of the entire pipeline.
sents.zh: LDM 的准确性从根本上受到 ST-VAE 重建性能的限制，这意味着 ST-VAE 最具挑战性的情况决定了整个流程的极限。

sents.en: Across the held-out scenes, the largest reconstruction errors mostly occur on geometries with many long, thin features.
sents.zh: 在所有预留的场景中，最大的重建误差主要出现在具有许多细长特征的几何结构上。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 12 illustrates a representative extreme case, a soft birdcage comprising 9,021 9{,}021 nodes, which is 1.8 1.8 times the 5,000 5{,}000 -vertex training cap and contains dozens of thin bars only a few tetrahedra thick. Its mean reconstruction error over the trajectory is 9.9 9.9 mm, about twice the held-out mean for meshes above the training cap (Table 1 ). This error is localized to the thin bars, which exhibit distorted and tangled reconstructions. Nevertheless, the overall shape of the collapsed cage, its pose, and its motion over the trajectory are all recovered.
paragraphs.zh: 图 12 展示了一个典型的极端案例：一个由 9,021 个节点组成的软质鸟笼，其节点数量是训练上限 5,000 顶点的 1.8 倍，且包含数十根仅厚几个四面体的细杆。 该鸟笼沿轨迹的平均重建误差为 9.9 毫米，约为超出训练上限的网格模型在验证集上的平均误差的两倍（表 1）。 这种误差集中在细杆部分，这些细杆的重建结果呈现出扭曲和纠缠的状态。 尽管如此，坍塌鸟笼的整体形状、姿态以及沿轨迹的运动过程均得到了恢复。

sents.en: Fig. 12 illustrates a representative extreme case, a soft birdcage comprising 9,021 9{,}021 nodes, which is 1.8 1.8 times the 5,000 5{,}000 -vertex training cap and contains dozens of thin bars only a few tetrahedra thick.
sents.zh: 图 12 展示了一个典型的极端案例：一个由 9,021 个节点组成的软质鸟笼，其节点数量是训练上限 5,000 顶点的 1.8 倍，且包含数十根仅厚几个四面体的细杆。

sents.en: Its mean reconstruction error over the trajectory is 9.9 9.9 mm, about twice the held-out mean for meshes above the training cap (Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 该鸟笼沿轨迹的平均重建误差为 9.9 毫米，约为超出训练上限的网格模型在验证集上的平均误差的两倍（表 1）。

sents.en: This error is localized to the thin bars, which exhibit distorted and tangled reconstructions.
sents.zh: 这种误差集中在细杆部分，这些细杆的重建结果呈现出扭曲和纠缠的状态。

sents.en: Nevertheless, the overall shape of the collapsed cage, its pose, and its motion over the trajectory are all recovered.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，坍塌鸟笼的整体形状、姿态以及沿轨迹的运动过程均得到了恢复。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, node count alone is not the primary performance bottleneck. For instance, the teaser mug shown in Fig. 1 represents a compact solid with 11,621 11{,}621 nodes ( 2.3 2.3 times the training cap) yet achieves a lower reconstruction error of 5.3 5.3 mm. What distinguishes the birdcage is the density of thin features that deform independently of each other. The folding of every bar is a high-frequency deformation, and the fixed-size latent has to carry it for dozens of bars at once. The latent has enough capacity for the global shape, but not for the fine detail of every bar.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，仅凭节点数量并非性能的主要瓶颈。 例如，图 1 中展示的预告杯是一个包含 11,621 个节点的紧凑实体（是训练上限的 2.3 倍），但其重建误差却更低，仅为 5.3 毫米。 鸟笼的独特之处在于其薄壁结构的密度，这些结构能够相互独立地发生形变。 每一根杆件的折叠都属于高频形变，而固定大小的潜在表示必须同时承载数十根杆件的这种形变。 潜在表示具备足够的容量来捕捉整体形状，却无法容纳每根杆件的精细细节。

sents.zh: 鸟笼的独特之处在于其薄壁结构的密度，这些结构能够相互独立地发生形变。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the multi-body extension of our method and presents its qualitative results. Our approach generalizes effectively to multi-object scenes. The factorization defined in Eq. ( 1 ) is applied at the scene level: a single global rigid transform ( 𝐑 t , 𝐜 t ) (\mathbf{R}_{t},\mathbf{c}_{t}) is fitted across the vertices of all bodies, while the relative motion among bodies is captured by the canonical deformation field 𝐝 t \mathbf{d}_{t} . Because the spatial VAE encodes all vertices within a scene through a shared set of K K query tokens, multi-body scenes are encoded, compressed, and predicted in the same manner as single-body objects, requiring no architectural modifications to the ST-VAE or the LDM.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了我们方法的多体扩展，并展示了其定性结果。我们的方法能有效推广到多物体场景。公式 (1) 中定义的因子分解在场景层面应用：一个全局的刚体变换（𝐑 t , 𝐜 t ）(\mathbf{R}_{t},\mathbf{c}_{t}) 被拟合到所有物体的顶点上，而物体之间的相对运动则由规范形变场 𝐝 t \mathbf{d}_{t} 捕捉。由于空间 VAE 通过共享的一组 K 个查询令牌对场景中的所有顶点进行编码，因此多体场景与单体物体以相同的方式被编码、压缩和预测，无需对 ST-VAE 或 LDM 的架构进行任何修改。

paragraphs.en: We train both the ST-VAE and the LDM on scenes containing up to three bodies ( n ≤ 3 n\leq 3 ), where randomly selected objects are thrown toward each other to collide in mid-air before hitting the ground. Each body is assigned an independent random Young’s modulus and initial velocity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在包含最多三个物体（n ≤ 3）的场景中训练 ST-VAE 和 LDM，其中随机选择的物体会相互投掷，在空中发生碰撞，然后撞击地面。 每个物体都被分配一个独立的随机杨氏模量和初始速度。

sents.en: We train both the ST-VAE and the LDM on scenes containing up to three bodies ( n ≤ 3 n\leq 3 ), where randomly selected objects are thrown toward each other to collide in mid-air before hitting the ground.
sents.zh: 我们在包含最多三个物体（n ≤ 3）的场景中训练 ST-VAE 和 LDM，其中随机选择的物体会相互投掷，在空中发生碰撞，然后撞击地面。

sents.en: Each body is assigned an independent random Young’s modulus and initial velocity.
sents.zh: 每个物体都被分配一个独立的随机杨氏模量和初始速度。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 13 illustrates the ST-VAE reconstruction on four multi-body scenes across four representative frames: immediately before and after the mid-air collision, the first frame following ground impact, and the final settled state. All bodies within each scene, including their collisions and ground contacts, are successfully reconstructed through the single global transform. Fig. 14 demonstrates one-shot prediction on four multi-body scenes conditioned on the initial state, with predictions rendered using the original textured assets. The entire scene, encompassing each individual body along with its collision dynamics and landing behavior, is predicted end-to-end in a single diffusion pass.
paragraphs.zh: 图 13 展示了 ST-VAE 在四个多物体场景中的重建结果，涵盖四个代表性帧：空中碰撞前后瞬间、地面撞击后的第一帧以及最终稳定状态。 每个场景中的所有物体，包括其碰撞和与地面的接触，都通过单一的全局变换成功重建。 图 14 展示了基于初始状态对四个多物体场景进行的一次性预测，预测结果使用原始带纹理的资产渲染。 整个场景，包括每个独立物体及其碰撞动力学和着陆行为，都在单次扩散过程中端到端地预测完成。

sents.en: Fig. 13 illustrates the ST-VAE reconstruction on four multi-body scenes across four representative frames: immediately before and after the mid-air collision, the first frame following ground impact, and the final settled state.
sents.zh: 图 13 展示了 ST-VAE 在四个多物体场景中的重建结果，涵盖四个代表性帧：空中碰撞前后瞬间、地面撞击后的第一帧以及最终稳定状态。

sents.zh: 每个场景中的所有物体，包括其碰撞和与地面的接触，都通过单一的全局变换成功重建。

sents.en: Fig. 14 demonstrates one-shot prediction on four multi-body scenes conditioned on the initial state, with predictions rendered using the original textured assets.

paragraphs.en: This section gives the setup and the full results of the two differentiable tasks of Sec. 4.2 . Both tasks run on the same scene and use the same model. The first, material estimation, needs a first-order gradient. The second, designing the throw, needs a second-order gradient. Table 13 summarizes how our model and the two differentiable simulators, DiffIPC ( Huang et al., 2024b ) and Newton/Warp, behave on them.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了第 4.2 节中两个可微分任务的设置及完整结果。 这两个任务均在同一场景上运行，并使用相同的模型。 第一个任务是材料估计，需要一阶梯度。 第二个任务是设计投掷动作，需要二阶梯度。 表 13 总结了我们的模型以及两个可微分模拟器 DiffIPC（Huang 等人，2024b）和 Newton/Warp 在这些任务上的表现。

sents.en: This section gives the setup and the full results of the two differentiable tasks of Sec. 4.2 .
sents.zh: 本节介绍了第 4.2 节中两个可微分任务的设置及完整结果。

sents.en: Both tasks run on the same scene and use the same model.
sents.zh: 这两个任务均在同一场景上运行，并使用相同的模型。

sents.en: The first, material estimation, needs a first-order gradient.
sents.zh: 第一个任务是材料估计，需要一阶梯度。

sents.en: The second, designing the throw, needs a second-order gradient.
sents.zh: 第二个任务是设计投掷动作，需要二阶梯度。

sents.en: Table 13 summarizes how our model and the two differentiable simulators, DiffIPC ( Huang et al., 2024b ) and Newton/Warp, behave on them.
sents.zh: 表 13 总结了我们的模型以及两个可微分模拟器 DiffIPC（Huang 等人，2024b）和 Newton/Warp 在这些任务上的表现。

paragraphs.en: The first task is to recover the Young’s modulus E ⋆ E^{\star} of a body from a single observed trajectory. Because E E enters our model through the scalar material channel, the mismatch between the predicted rollout and the observation is end-to-end differentiable with respect to log ⁡ E \log E . Starting from initial guesses up to 1.1 dex away from seven ground-truth moduli E ⋆ ∈ [ 3 ⋅ 10 4 , 3 ⋅ 10 6 ] E^{\star}\in[3{\cdot}10^{4},3{\cdot}10^{6}] , our model successfully recovers all seven within 0.06 0.06 dex in just 40 Adam steps ( ∼ \sim 40 seconds). Figure 15 compares the observed, initial, and recovered trajectories and shows the estimation error across all seven moduli.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个任务是仅根据一条观测到的轨迹，恢复物体的杨氏模量 E ⋆ E^{\star}。 由于 E 通过标量材料通道进入我们的模型，因此预测的展开轨迹与观测结果之间的差异相对于 log ⁡ E \log E 是全链路可微分的。 从初始猜测值（与七个真实模量 E ⋆ ∈ [ 3 ⋅ 10 4 , 3 ⋅ 10 6 ] E^{\star}\in[3{\cdot}10^{4},3{\cdot}10^{6}] 的偏差最大可达 1.1 dex）开始，我们的模型在仅 40 个 Adam 步（约 ∼ \sim 40 秒）内，成功将全部七个模量的恢复误差控制在 0.06 dex 以内。 图 15 对比了观测到的、初始的以及恢复后的轨迹，并展示了全部七个模量的估计误差。

sents.en: The first task is to recover the Young’s modulus E ⋆ E^{\star} of a body from a single observed trajectory.
sents.zh: 第一个任务是仅根据一条观测到的轨迹，恢复物体的杨氏模量 E ⋆ E^{\star}。

sents.en: Because E E enters our model through the scalar material channel, the mismatch between the predicted rollout and the observation is end-to-end differentiable with respect to log ⁡ E \log E .
sents.zh: 由于 E 通过标量材料通道进入我们的模型，因此预测的展开轨迹与观测结果之间的差异相对于 log ⁡ E \log E 是全链路可微分的。

sents.en: Starting from initial guesses up to 1.1 dex away from seven ground-truth moduli E ⋆ ∈ [ 3 ⋅ 10 4 , 3 ⋅ 10 6 ] E^{\star}\in[3{\cdot}10^{4},3{\cdot}10^{6}] , our model successfully recovers all seven within 0.06 0.06 dex in just 40 Adam steps ( ∼ \sim 40 seconds).
sents.zh: 从初始猜测值（与七个真实模量 E ⋆ ∈ [ 3 ⋅ 10 4 , 3 ⋅ 10 6 ] E^{\star}\in[3{\cdot}10^{4},3{\cdot}10^{6}] 的偏差最大可达 1.1 dex）开始，我们的模型在仅 40 个 Adam 步（约 ∼ \sim 40 秒）内，成功将全部七个模量的恢复误差控制在 0.06 dex 以内。

sents.en: Figure 15 compares the observed, initial, and recovered trajectories and shows the estimation error across all seven moduli.
sents.zh: 图 15 对比了观测到的、初始的以及恢复后的轨迹，并展示了全部七个模量的估计误差。

paragraphs.en: Existing differentiable simulators already have difficulty with this first-order task. DiffIPC does not converge under default settings and only runs stably after manual tuning of the solver parameters, and then needs about 26 minutes. Newton/Warp, meanwhile, fails on this task: it consumes massive memory (49 GB tape for 131k substeps) before its gradients explode through the complex dynamics simulation, resulting in random gradient signs and total optimization failure.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的可微分模拟器在执行这一阶任务时就已经存在困难。 DiffIPC 在默认设置下无法收敛，只有在手动调整求解器参数后才能稳定运行，即便如此也需要大约 26 分钟。 与此同时，Newton/Warp 在这一任务上失败了：它在通过复杂动力学模拟时梯度爆炸之前，就消耗了巨大的内存（13.1 万个子步骤需要 49 GB 的磁带），导致梯度符号随机化并完全优化失败。

paragraphs.en: Building on the first task, we ask a further question: which throw makes the stiffness easiest to estimate? A throw is informative when a small change in E E produces a large change in the resulting trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一个任务的基础上，我们提出另一个问题：哪种投掷方式最容易估算出刚度？ 当 E 的微小变化导致最终轨迹发生显著改变时，这种投掷方式就具有信息价值。

sents.en: Building on the first task, we ask a further question: which throw makes the stiffness easiest to estimate?
sents.zh: 在第一个任务的基础上，我们提出另一个问题：哪种投掷方式最容易估算出刚度？

sents.en: A throw is informative when a small change in E E produces a large change in the resulting trajectory.
sents.zh: 当 E 的微小变化导致最终轨迹发生显著改变时，这种投掷方式就具有信息价值。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, how large this trajectory change is depends on the stiffness of the body itself. Therefore, the trajectory sensitivity must be evaluated at a specific value of E E , which we set to E ⋆ E^{\star} ( 6 ⋅ 10 4 6{\cdot}10^{4} Pa). The design is thus local: it finds the most informative throw for a body of roughly this stiffness, assuming a rough estimate of the stiffness is already available. To ensure robustness against launch errors, we maximize the sensitivity of the predicted rigid motion to log 10 ⁡ E \log_{10}E , averaged over eight small perturbations of the release velocity v 0 v_{0} . Because the objective itself is a derivative, maximizing it via gradient ascent fundamentally requires a second-order gradient .
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，这种轨迹变化的幅度取决于物体本身的刚度。 因此，必须在 E 的一个特定值处评估轨迹灵敏度，我们将其设为 E ⋆（6 ⋅ 10⁴ Pa）。 因此，该设计是局部性的：它会在假设已有一个粗略的刚度估计值的前提下，为具有大致如此刚度的物体找到信息量最大的投掷方式。 为确保对发射误差的鲁棒性，我们最大化了预测的刚性运动对 log₁₀E 的灵敏度，并对释放速度 v₀ 的八个小扰动进行了平均。 由于目标函数本身是一个导数，通过梯度上升法对其进行最大化，本质上需要二阶梯度。

paragraphs.en: Our model supports higher-order derivatives and provides this second-order gradient directly via reverse-mode automatic differentiation. In just 30 Adam steps (7 minutes), our model successfully optimizes the throw. Replaying this designed throw in the ground-truth solver confirms its effectiveness: the sensitivity of the rigid motion to E E increases by 13 × 13\times , and per-vertex sensitivity by 1.85 × 1.85\times . This highly informative trajectory significantly widens the basin of attraction, enabling successful E E recovery even from a distant initial guess ( E 0 = 10 6 E_{0}=10^{6} ) where the original throw stalls. Figure 16 visualizes the ground-truth trajectories of the initial and the optimized throw, the sensitivity gain, and the subsequent material-estimation runs from this distant initial guess.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的模型支持高阶导数，并通过反向模式自动微分直接提供这种二阶梯度。 仅用 30 次 Adam 步（7 分钟），我们的模型就成功优化了投掷动作。 在真实值求解器中重演这个设计好的投掷动作，可以验证其有效性：刚体运动对 E E 的敏感度增加了 13 × 13\times，每个顶点的敏感度则增加了 1.85 × 1.85\times。 这条信息量极大的轨迹显著扩大了吸引盆的范围，使得即使从较远的初始猜测（E_{0}=10^{6}）也能成功恢复 E E，而原始投掷动作在此处会停滞。 图 16 展示了初始投掷和优化后投掷的真实值轨迹、敏感度增益，以及从该遥远初始猜测开始的后续材料估计运行结果。

sents.en: Figure 16 visualizes the ground-truth trajectories of the initial and the optimized throw, the sensitivity gain, and the subsequent material-estimation runs from this distant initial guess.
sents.zh: 图 16 展示了初始投掷和优化后投掷的真实值轨迹、敏感度增益，以及从该遥远初始猜测开始的后续材料估计运行结果。

paragraphs.en: If the first-order task is already this challenging for existing solvers, this second-order throw design becomes infeasible for them. DiffIPC is inherently limited to first-order analytic adjoints; forcing it to approximate the necessary second-order gradient requires nested finite differences ( 64 64 forward solves per step). As a result, a single gradient step takes 2.4 hours, about 635 × 635\times slower than our model. The whole design would therefore take about three days, which is not acceptable in practice. For Newton/Warp, which already fails to produce a usable first-order gradient, such higher-order applications are insurmountable. In contrast, PhysLDM effortlessly scales to these advanced demands, acting as a fast, stable surrogate that natively supports higher-order derivatives. Table 13 summarizes the comparison on both tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 如果现有求解器处理一阶任务就已经如此困难，那么这种二阶的“投掷”设计对他们来说就不可行了。 DiffIPC 本质上仅限于一阶解析伴随；若要强制其近似必要的二阶梯度，就需要使用嵌套有限差分法（每步需要 64×64 次前向求解）。 因此，单次梯度步骤需要 2.4 小时，比我们模型慢约 635 倍。 所以，整个设计大约需要三天时间，这在实践中是不可接受的。 对于 Newton/Warp 而言，它甚至无法生成可用的梯度，更不用说处理这类高阶应用了。 相比之下，PhysLDM 能够轻松应对这些高级需求，作为一个快速、稳定的代理模型，原生支持高阶导数。 表 13 总结了在这两项任务上的对比结果。

paragraphs.en: This section compares PhysLDM with the concurrent one-shot model of Chen et al. (2026) . That model is a diffusion transformer with factorized spatiotemporal attention that denoises the full T T -frame trajectory directly on vertex × \times frame tokens, without any latent, and it was trained on low-resolution surface meshes (about 356 356 vertices per scene, 35 35 templates). Because its cost grows with the number of vertices times the number of frames, it cannot be trained at the resolution of our dataset, so the two models cannot be compared directly on our full data. We therefore compare them in two steps. First, we measure the vertex count up to which the raw-coordinate formulation fits in memory at all. Second, we choose a resolution where it does fit, train both models on the same data there, and compare their training cost and generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 本节将 PhysLDM 与 Chen 等人（2026）提出的并行单样本模型进行了比较。 该模型是一种具有因子化时空注意力的扩散变换器，它直接在顶点 × 帧的标记上对完整的 T 帧轨迹进行去噪，且不使用任何潜在变量；其训练数据为低分辨率表面网格（每场景约 356 个顶点，共 35 个模板）。 由于该模型的成本随顶点数与帧数的乘积而增长，因此无法在与我们数据集相同的分辨率上进行训练，所以这两个模型无法在我们的完整数据上直接比较。 因此，我们分两个步骤对它们进行比较。 首先，我们测量原始坐标表示形式在内存中能够容纳的最大顶点数量。 其次，我们选择一个该模型能够运行的分辨率，在此分辨率下用相同的数据训练两个模型，并比较它们的训练成本和生成质量。

paragraphs.en: At a resolution where the concurrent model does fit in memory, we train both models from scratch under the same conditions. We train the concurrent model’s DiT-B variant with their training procedure and our full three-stage pipeline on the same training scenes with at most 1,000 1{,}000 vertices. The comparison is budget-matched: both models are trained on the same scenes on the same GPUs, the concurrent DiT-B has the same width and depth as our LDM, and each deploys its validation-selected checkpoint. paragraphs.en: Fig. 17 compares the predictions of the two models on four held-out scenes at this resolution, shown at the last frame of the trajectory. Both models place the object roughly where the ground truth places it. The difference is in the geometric detail. The concurrent model produces surfaces that are visibly noisy: the block bends and its faces ripple, the spoon and the shaft of the screwdriver are corrugated, and the bottle is lumpy. The zoom-in views show this noise on every surface. Our model keeps the shape of every object and its surfaces stay smooth.
paragraphs.zh: 图 17 比较了两种模型在此分辨率下对四个预留场景的预测结果，这些结果显示在轨迹的最后一帧中。 两种模型都将物体大致放置在真实数据所指示的位置。 差异体现在几何细节上。 并发模型生成的表面明显带有噪声：方块发生弯曲且其表面出现波纹，勺子和螺丝刀柄呈波浪状，瓶子则显得凹凸不平。 放大视图显示，这种噪声存在于每个表面上。 我们的模型能保持每个物体的形状，并且其表面始终保持光滑。

sents.en: Fig. 17 compares the predictions of the two models on four held-out scenes at this resolution, shown at the last frame of the trajectory.
sents.zh: 图 17 比较了两种模型在此分辨率下对四个预留场景的预测结果，这些结果显示在轨迹的最后一帧中。

sents.en: Both models place the object roughly where the ground truth places it.
sents.zh: 两种模型都将物体大致放置在真实数据所指示的位置。

sents.en: The difference is in the geometric detail.
sents.zh: 差异体现在几何细节上。

sents.en: The concurrent model produces surfaces that are visibly noisy: the block bends and its faces ripple, the spoon and the shaft of the screwdriver are corrugated, and the bottle is lumpy.
sents.zh: 并发模型生成的表面明显带有噪声：方块发生弯曲且其表面出现波纹，勺子和螺丝刀柄呈波浪状，瓶子则显得凹凸不平。

sents.en: The zoom-in views show this noise on every surface.
sents.zh: 放大视图显示，这种噪声存在于每个表面上。

sents.en: Our model keeps the shape of every object and its surfaces stay smooth.
sents.zh: 我们的模型能保持每个物体的形状，并且其表面始终保持光滑。

paragraphs.en: The reason lies in where each model generates geometry. Our ST-VAE is pretrained to reconstruct shapes, so the decoder maps any latent it receives to a clean shape on the learned manifold. A small error in the latent predicted by the LDM therefore becomes a small, coherent change of the shape, and the geometric detail is preserved. The concurrent model predicts every vertex coordinate directly, so there is nothing between its prediction and the geometry. A small error in any coordinate appears on the surface as is, and the many small errors of a diffusion model add up to noisy geometric detail.
paragraphs.zh: 原因在于每个模型生成几何体的方式不同。 我们的 ST-VAE 经过预训练以重构形状，因此解码器会将接收到的任何潜在变量映射到已学习流形上的干净形状。 因此，LDM 预测的潜在变量中的微小误差会转化为形状上微小而连贯的变化，从而保留几何细节。 并行模型直接预测每个顶点的坐标，因此其预测结果与几何体之间没有任何中间环节。 任何坐标上的微小误差都会原样出现在表面上，而扩散模型中众多的微小误差会累积成嘈杂的几何细节。

sents.en: The reason lies in where each model generates geometry.
sents.zh: 原因在于每个模型生成几何体的方式不同。

sents.en: Our ST-VAE is pretrained to reconstruct shapes, so the decoder maps any latent it receives to a clean shape on the learned manifold.
sents.zh: 我们的 ST-VAE 经过预训练以重构形状，因此解码器会将接收到的任何潜在变量映射到已学习流形上的干净形状。

sents.en: A small error in the latent predicted by the LDM therefore becomes a small, coherent change of the shape, and the geometric detail is preserved.
sents.zh: 因此，LDM 预测的潜在变量中的微小误差会转化为形状上微小而连贯的变化，从而保留几何细节。

sents.en: The concurrent model predicts every vertex coordinate directly, so there is nothing between its prediction and the geometry.
sents.zh: 并行模型直接预测每个顶点的坐标，因此其预测结果与几何体之间没有任何中间环节。

sents.en: A small error in any coordinate appears on the surface as is, and the many small errors of a diffusion model add up to noisy geometric detail.
sents.zh: 任何坐标上的微小误差都会原样出现在表面上，而扩散模型中众多的微小误差会累积成嘈杂的几何细节。

paragraphs.en: This problem is not visible in the concurrent work’s own demonstrations because meshes in their training data are simple and coarse, with at most a few hundred vertices, and the whole dataset is built from only a few dozen mesh templates. A model can learn these few simple shapes accurately with much less difficulty. On our data, with thousands of distinct objects at native resolution, learning the geometry itself becomes much harder.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题在现有相关工作的演示中并不明显，因为它们的训练数据中的网格非常简单且粗糙，最多只有几百个顶点，而整个数据集也仅由几十个网格模板构建而成。 模型可以毫不费力地准确学习这几种简单的形状。 在我们的数据中，由于存在数千个具有原始分辨率的独特物体，学习几何结构本身变得困难得多。

sents.en: This problem is not visible in the concurrent work’s own demonstrations because meshes in their training data are simple and coarse, with at most a few hundred vertices, and the whole dataset is built from only a few dozen mesh templates.

paragraphs.en: Our model is also much faster at inference. The concurrent model denoises N × 64 N\times 64 vertex tokens, so its latency grows with the mesh, whereas our LDM denoises the fixed 4,104 4{,}104 latent tokens. On a scene of about 1,000 1{,}000 vertices, our model predicts a 64 64 -frame trajectory in about 1.5 1.5 s at 50 50 sampling steps and 0.8 0.8 s at 20 20 , while the concurrent model needs about 12.9 12.9 s and 5.1 5.1 s, so ours is roughly 9 × 9\times and 6 × 6\times faster.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的模型在推理速度上也快得多。 并行模型会去噪 N × 64 N\times 64 个顶点令牌，因此其延迟会随着网格增大而增加，而我们的 LDM 则去噪固定的 4,104 4{,}104 个潜在令牌。 在一个约有 1,000 1{,}1000 个顶点的场景中，我们的模型在 50 50 次采样步数下，约 1.5 1.5 秒即可预测一个 64 64 帧的轨迹；在 20 20 次采样步数下则仅需约 0.8 0.8 秒。而并行模型则需要约 12.9 12.9 秒和 5.1 5.1 秒，因此我们的模型分别快约 9 × 9\times 和 6 × 6\times。

sents.en: Our model is also much faster at inference.
sents.zh: 我们的模型在推理速度上也快得多。

sents.en: The concurrent model denoises N × 64 N\times 64 vertex tokens, so its latency grows with the mesh, whereas our LDM denoises the fixed 4,104 4{,}104 latent tokens.

paragraphs.en: PhysLDM is trained with kinematic supervision only (Sec. 3.3 ). No energy model or material law enters the data format, the losses, or the architecture. This design gives PhysLDM three practical advantages, which we test in this section.
paragraphs.zh: PhysLDM 仅通过运动学监督进行训练（第 3.3 节）。 数据格式、损失函数或架构中均未引入任何能量模型或材料定律。 这种设计为 PhysLDM 带来了三个实际优势，我们将在本节中进行测试。

sents.en: PhysLDM is trained with kinematic supervision only (Sec. 3.3 ).
sents.zh: PhysLDM 仅通过运动学监督进行训练（第 3.3 节）。

sents.en: No energy model or material law enters the data format, the losses, or the architecture.
sents.zh: 数据格式、损失函数或架构中均未引入任何能量模型或材料定律。

sents.en: This design gives PhysLDM three practical advantages, which we test in this section.
sents.zh: 这种设计为 PhysLDM 带来了三个实际优势，我们将在本节中进行测试。

paragraphs.en: Diverse energy models. Because the constitutive model never enters training, the same pipeline can learn from simulations with any energy model.
paragraphs.zh: 多样的能量模型。 由于本构模型从未进入训练阶段，相同的流程可以从使用任何能量模型的模拟中学习。

sents.en: Diverse energy models.
sents.zh: 多样的能量模型。

sents.en: Because the constitutive model never enters training, the same pipeline can learn from simulations with any energy model.
sents.zh: 由于本构模型从未进入训练阶段，相同的流程可以从使用任何能量模型的模拟中学习。

paragraphs.en: Data without an explicit energy model. For the same reason, PhysLDM can learn from trajectories with only an implicit energy model, such as trajectories captured in the real world.
paragraphs.zh: 没有显式能量模型的数据。 出于同样的原因，PhysLDM 可以从仅具有隐式能量模型的轨迹中学习，例如在真实世界中捕捉到的轨迹。

sents.en: Data without an explicit energy model.
sents.zh: 没有显式能量模型的数据。

sents.en: For the same reason, PhysLDM can learn from trajectories with only an implicit energy model, such as trajectories captured in the real world.
sents.zh: 出于同样的原因，PhysLDM 可以从仅具有隐式能量模型的轨迹中学习，例如在真实世界中捕捉到的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Seamless support for other data formats, such as surface meshes and point clouds. Our training data are tetrahedral meshes, but PhysLDM does not depend on the tetrahedra themselves. The spatial VAE only takes vertex positions and a graph over the vertices. For a tetrahedral mesh, the graph is given by the tetrahedral edges. A surface mesh fits this structure naturally, with its triangle edges as the graph. For a point cloud, we can use a k k -nearest-neighbor graph or no edges at all. PhysLDM therefore runs on these formats without any change to the model or the training code. Because our input does not need to be a tetrahedral mesh, PhysLDM also supports object types beyond volumetric solids, such as cloth and rope, which are usually not represented with tetrahedra.
paragraphs.zh: 无缝支持其他数据格式，例如表面网格和点云。 我们的训练数据是四面体网格，但 PhysLDM 并不依赖于四面体本身。 空间 VAE 仅接收顶点位置和顶点之间的图结构。 对于四面体网格，该图由四面体的边构成。 表面网格能自然地适配这种结构，其三角形的边即为图结构。 对于点云，我们可以使用 k 最近邻图，或者完全不使用边。 因此，PhysLDM 无需对模型或训练代码进行任何修改即可在这些格式上运行。 由于输入不必是四面体网格，PhysLDM 还支持体积实体之外的对象类型，例如布料和绳索，这些通常不用四面体来表示。

sents.en: Seamless support for other data formats, such as surface meshes and point clouds.
sents.zh: 无缝支持其他数据格式，例如表面网格和点云。

sents.zh: 我们的训练数据是四面体网格，但 PhysLDM 并不依赖于四面体本身。

sents.en: The spatial VAE only takes vertex positions and a graph over the vertices.
sents.zh: 空间 VAE 仅接收顶点位置和顶点之间的图结构。

sents.en: For a tetrahedral mesh, the graph is given by the tetrahedral edges.
sents.zh: 对于四面体网格，该图由四面体的边构成。

sents.en: A surface mesh fits this structure naturally, with its triangle edges as the graph.
sents.zh: 表面网格能自然地适配这种结构，其三角形的边即为图结构。

sents.en: For a point cloud, we can use a k k -nearest-neighbor graph or no edges at all.
sents.zh: 对于点云，我们可以使用 k 最近邻图，或者完全不使用边。

sents.en: PhysLDM therefore runs on these formats without any change to the model or the training code.
sents.zh: 因此，PhysLDM 无需对模型或训练代码进行任何修改即可在这些格式上运行。

sents.en: Because our input does not need to be a tetrahedral mesh, PhysLDM also supports object types beyond volumetric solids, such as cloth and rope, which are usually not represented with tetrahedra.
sents.zh: 由于输入不必是四面体网格，PhysLDM 还支持体积实体之外的对象类型，例如布料和绳索，这些通常不用四面体来表示。

paragraphs.en: We test these advantages in two steps. First, we apply the pretrained PhysLDM, trained only on Stable Neo-Hookean simulations of Objaverse meshes, to new data without any adaptation. Second, we fine-tune it on the new data with the unchanged training code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过两个步骤来检验这些优势。 首先，我们将仅基于 Objaverse 网格的 Stable Neo-Hookean 模拟进行预训练的 PhysLDM，直接应用于新数据，而无需任何调整。 其次，我们使用未更改的训练代码，在新数据上对其进行微调。

sents.en: We test these advantages in two steps.
sents.zh: 我们通过两个步骤来检验这些优势。

sents.en: First, we apply the pretrained PhysLDM, trained only on Stable Neo-Hookean simulations of Objaverse meshes, to new data without any adaptation.
sents.zh: 首先，我们将仅基于 Objaverse 网格的 Stable Neo-Hookean 模拟进行预训练的 PhysLDM，直接应用于新数据，而无需任何调整。

sents.en: Second, we fine-tune it on the new data with the unchanged training code.
sents.zh: 其次，我们使用未更改的训练代码，在新数据上对其进行微调。

paragraphs.en: Diverse energy models. We take 40 40 held-out Objaverse scenes and simulate each scene twice with StiffGIPC from the same initial state. The first run uses the Stable Neo-Hookean energy of the training data ( Smith et al., 2018 ) . The second run uses an as-rigid-as-possible (ARAP) energy ( Sorkine and Alexa, 2007 ) with the same shear stiffness and no volume term, so the objects are softer and more compressible. The two energies move the trajectories 28 28 mm apart (median over scenes). We exclude the chaotic scenes of Appendix D , so this difference comes from the energy model and not from solver noise.
paragraphs.zh: 多样的能量模型。 我们采用 40 个预留的 Objaverse 场景，并使用 StiffGIPC 从相同的初始状态对每个场景进行两次模拟。 第一次运行使用训练数据中的稳定新胡克能量（Smith 等人，2018）。 第二次运行使用尽可能刚体（ARAP）能量（Sorkine 和 Alexa，2007），并保持相同的剪切刚度且不含体积项，因此物体更柔软、更具压缩性。 这两种能量使轨迹之间产生 28 毫米的位移（各场景的中位数）。 我们排除了附录 D 中的混沌场景，因此这种差异源于能量模型，而非求解器噪声。

sents.en: Diverse energy models.
sents.zh: 多样的能量模型。

sents.en: We take 40 40 held-out Objaverse scenes and simulate each scene twice with StiffGIPC from the same initial state.
sents.zh: 我们采用 40 个预留的 Objaverse 场景，并使用 StiffGIPC 从相同的初始状态对每个场景进行两次模拟。

sents.en: The first run uses the Stable Neo-Hookean energy of the training data ( Smith et al., 2018 ) .
sents.zh: 第一次运行使用训练数据中的稳定新胡克能量（Smith 等人，2018）。

sents.en: The second run uses an as-rigid-as-possible (ARAP) energy ( Sorkine and Alexa, 2007 ) with the same shear stiffness and no volume term, so the objects are softer and more compressible.
sents.zh: 第二次运行使用尽可能刚体（ARAP）能量（Sorkine 和 Alexa，2007），并保持相同的剪切刚度且不含体积项，因此物体更柔软、更具压缩性。

sents.en: The two energies move the trajectories 28 28 mm apart (median over scenes).
sents.zh: 这两种能量使轨迹之间产生 28 毫米的位移（各场景的中位数）。

sents.en: We exclude the chaotic scenes of Appendix D , so this difference comes from the energy model and not from solver noise.
sents.zh: 我们排除了附录 D 中的混沌场景，因此这种差异源于能量模型，而非求解器噪声。

paragraphs.en: Real captured point clouds. We use 22 22 real captured sequences from Jiang et al. (2025) : 9 9 soft volumetric objects (plush toys and a package), 8 8 pieces of cloth, and 5 5 ropes, each lifted, pushed, or stretched by a human hand on a table. The data are 3D points tracked over time with three RGB-D cameras, with 616 616 to 7,826 7{,}826 points per object. There is no mesh and no explicit energy model, and the forces of the human hand are not observed. The setting of these scenes is also very different from that of our training data. In our simulations, every object is released in the air with an initial velocity and falls onto the ground. In the captured sequences, the object rests on a table and is manipulated by a human hand. The real data are therefore out of domain for PhysLDM. We store the tracked points as the vertices and a k k -nearest-neighbor graph ( k = 8 k=8 ) as the topology, in the same file format as our simulated data. PhysLDM is thus seamlessly compatible with these data, without any change to our code.
paragraphs.zh: 真实采集的点云数据。我们使用了 Jiang et al. (2025) 提供的 22 个真实采集序列：9 个软体积物体（毛绒玩具和一个包裹）、8 块布料以及 5 条绳索，每个物体都由人手在桌面上抬起、推动或拉伸。这些数据是通过三台 RGB-D 相机随时间追踪得到的 3D 点云，每个物体包含 616 至 7,826 个点。这些数据既没有网格，也没有显式的能量模型，且人手的力也未被观测到。这些场景的设置也与我们的训练数据大相径庭。在我们的模拟中，每个物体都以初始速度被释放到空中并落到地面上；而在真实采集的序列中，物体则静止在桌面上并由人手进行操控。因此，这些真实数据对于 PhysLDM 而言属于域外数据。我们将追踪到的点云存储为顶点，并以 k 最近邻图（k = 8）表示其拓扑结构，文件格式与我们的模拟数据相同。因此，PhysLDM 无需对代码进行任何修改，即可与这些数据无缝兼容。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation. We use the metrics of Table 2 (Appendix B.4 ): the volume violation rate, the deformation-to-rigid kinetic energy ratio, and the world-coordinate error, each reported as the median over scenes. The first two need tetrahedra and are not defined on the point clouds.
paragraphs.zh: 评估。 我们使用表 2（附录 B.4）中的指标：体积违反率、形变与刚性动能之比以及世界坐标误差，每个指标均以各场景的中位数报告。 前两个指标需要四面体，且无法在点云上定义。

sents.en: Evaluation.
sents.zh: 评估。

sents.en: We use the metrics of Table 2 (Appendix B.4 ): the volume violation rate, the deformation-to-rigid kinetic energy ratio, and the world-coordinate error, each reported as the median over scenes.
sents.zh: 我们使用表 2（附录 B.4）中的指标：体积违反率、形变与刚性动能之比以及世界坐标误差，每个指标均以各场景的中位数报告。

sents.en: The first two need tetrahedra and are not defined on the point clouds.
sents.zh: 前两个指标需要四面体，且无法在点云上定义。

paragraphs.en: Table 16 applies the pretrained PhysLDM to the new data without any adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 表 16 将预训练的 PhysLDM 直接应用于新数据，未进行任何适配。

paragraphs.en: The ST-VAE generalizes zero-shot across energy models and to real point clouds. On the simulated scenes, the reconstruction error is 4.5 4.5 mm with Stable Neo-Hookean and 4.6 4.6 mm with ARAP. On the real point clouds it is 6.0 6.0 mm. This is the most demanding test: the scenes show manipulation by a human hand instead of objects thrown onto the ground, the data are real captures instead of simulations, the input is a point cloud instead of a tetrahedral mesh, and cloth and rope never appear in training. Even on this out-of-domain data, the ST-VAE reconstructs the motion accurately without any adaptation. Although the ST-VAE was trained only on Stable Neo-Hookean simulations, it represents motion under an unseen energy model (ARAP) and real motion without an explicit energy model almost as accurately (Fig. 18 ). This shows that its latent space is not tied to the energy model of the training data.
paragraphs.zh: ST-VAE 能够跨能量模型实现零样本泛化，并适用于真实点云。 在模拟场景中，使用 Stable Neo-Hookean 模型的重建误差为 4.5 毫米，使用 ARAP 模型则为 4.6 毫米。 在真实点云上，该误差为 6.0 毫米。 这是最具挑战性的测试：场景展示的是人手操作而非物体被抛向地面，数据是真实采集而非模拟，输入是点云而非四面体网格，且训练过程中从未出现过布料和绳索。 即使在这种域外数据上，ST-VAE 也能无需任何适应即可准确重建运动。 尽管 ST-VAE 仅在 Stable Neo-Hookean 模拟上进行训练，但它对未见过的能量模型（ARAP）下的运动以及没有显式能量模型的真实运动，几乎能同样准确地表示（图 18）。 这表明其潜在空间并未与训练数据的能量模型绑定。

sents.en: The ST-VAE generalizes zero-shot across energy models and to real point clouds.
sents.zh: ST-VAE 能够跨能量模型实现零样本泛化，并适用于真实点云。

sents.en: On the simulated scenes, the reconstruction error is 4.5 4.5 mm with Stable Neo-Hookean and 4.6 4.6 mm with ARAP.
sents.zh: 在模拟场景中，使用 Stable Neo-Hookean 模型的重建误差为 4.5 毫米，使用 ARAP 模型则为 4.6 毫米。

sents.en: On the real point clouds it is 6.0 6.0 mm.
sents.zh: 在真实点云上，该误差为 6.0 毫米。

sents.en: This is the most demanding test: the scenes show manipulation by a human hand instead of objects thrown onto the ground, the data are real captures instead of simulations, the input is a point cloud instead of a tetrahedral mesh, and cloth and rope never appear in training.
sents.zh: 这是最具挑战性的测试：场景展示的是人手操作而非物体被抛向地面，数据是真实采集而非模拟，输入是点云而非四面体网格，且训练过程中从未出现过布料和绳索。

sents.en: Even on this out-of-domain data, the ST-VAE reconstructs the motion accurately without any adaptation.
sents.zh: 即使在这种域外数据上，ST-VAE 也能无需任何适应即可准确重建运动。

sents.en: Although the ST-VAE was trained only on Stable Neo-Hookean simulations, it represents motion under an unseen energy model (ARAP) and real motion without an explicit energy model almost as accurately (Fig. 18 ).
sents.zh: 尽管 ST-VAE 仅在 Stable Neo-Hookean 模拟上进行训练，但它对未见过的能量模型（ARAP）下的运动以及没有显式能量模型的真实运动，几乎能同样准确地表示（图 18）。

sents.en: This shows that its latent space is not tied to the energy model of the training data.
sents.zh: 这表明其潜在空间并未与训练数据的能量模型绑定。

paragraphs.en: The LDM prediction depends on the training data. On the simulated scenes with Stable Neo-Hookean, the prediction error is 23.9 23.9 mm, in line with Table 2 . With ARAP, the error grows to 37.5 37.5 mm and the kinetic energy ratio drops to 0.79 0.79 : the LDM predicts the deformation of the material it was trained on, while the ARAP objects deform more. On the real sequences, the zero-shot prediction fails ( 875 875 mm) because of the domain gap, not the energy model. The LDM has only learned objects thrown onto the ground, while the real object stays on the table until the human hand moves it.
paragraphs.zh: LDM 的预测依赖于训练数据。 在采用 Stable Neo-Hookean 模型的模拟场景中，预测误差为 23.9 23.9 毫米，与表 2 一致。 使用 ARAP 时，误差增至 37.5 37.5 毫米，动能比则降至 0.79 0.79：LDM 预测的是其训练所用材料的形变，而 ARAP 处理的物体形变更大。 在真实序列中，零样本预测失败了（875 875 毫米），原因是领域差异，而非能量模型的问题。 LDM 仅学会了被抛到地面上的物体，而真实物体在人类用手移动它之前一直停留在桌子上。

sents.en: The LDM prediction depends on the training data.
sents.zh: LDM 的预测依赖于训练数据。

sents.en: On the simulated scenes with Stable Neo-Hookean, the prediction error is 23.9 23.9 mm, in line with Table 2 .
sents.zh: 在采用 Stable Neo-Hookean 模型的模拟场景中，预测误差为 23.9 23.9 毫米，与表 2 一致。

sents.en: With ARAP, the error grows to 37.5 37.5 mm and the kinetic energy ratio drops to 0.79 0.79 : the LDM predicts the deformation of the material it was trained on, while the ARAP objects deform more.
sents.zh: 使用 ARAP 时，误差增至 37.5 37.5 毫米，动能比则降至 0.79 0.79：LDM 预测的是其训练所用材料的形变，而 ARAP 处理的物体形变更大。

sents.en: On the real sequences, the zero-shot prediction fails ( 875 875 mm) because of the domain gap, not the energy model.
sents.zh: 在真实序列中，零样本预测失败了（875 875 毫米），原因是领域差异，而非能量模型的问题。

sents.en: The LDM has only learned objects thrown onto the ground, while the real object stays on the table until the human hand moves it.
sents.zh: LDM 仅学会了被抛到地面上的物体，而真实物体在人类用手移动它之前一直停留在桌子上。

paragraphs.en: To adapt PhysLDM to new data, we only replace the training data with the new trajectories and fine-tune the LDM from the pretrained weights with the same trainer. The ST-VAE stays frozen. The same procedure applies to both energy models and to the real point clouds. Table 17 reports the results on the fine-tuning subsets, so the values before fine-tuning differ slightly from Table 16 . For both explicit energy models, the prediction error drops by about two thirds, to 7.6 7.6 mm and 8.8 8.8 mm. For ARAP, the kinetic energy ratio moves from 0.80 0.80 to 0.92 0.92 , so the LDM learns the softer material from the trajectories alone. On the real point clouds, the error drops from 921 921 to 6.2 6.2 mm: the LDM learns from the tracked points that a resting object stays on the table and how the points move (Fig. 18 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了将 PhysLDM 适应新数据，我们只需将训练数据替换为新轨迹，并使用相同的训练器基于预训练权重对 LDM 进行微调。ST-VAE 保持冻结状态。 同样的流程也适用于能量模型和真实点云。 表 17 报告了微调子集上的结果，因此微调前的数值与表 16 略有不同。 对于两种显式能量模型，预测误差均下降了约三分之二，降至 7.6 毫米和 8.8 毫米。 对于 ARAP，动能比从 0.80 变为 0.92，因此 LDM 仅通过轨迹就学会了更柔软的材料特性。 在真实点云上，误差从 921 毫米降至 6.2 毫米：LDM 从跟踪点中学到静止物体会留在桌上，以及这些点如何移动（图 18）。

sents.en: To adapt PhysLDM to new data, we only replace the training data with the new trajectories and fine-tune the LDM from the pretrained weights with the same trainer. The ST-VAE stays frozen.
sents.zh: 为了将 PhysLDM 适应新数据，我们只需将训练数据替换为新轨迹，并使用相同的训练器基于预训练权重对 LDM 进行微调。ST-VAE 保持冻结状态。

sents.en: The same procedure applies to both energy models and to the real point clouds.
sents.zh: 同样的流程也适用于能量模型和真实点云。

sents.en: Table 17 reports the results on the fine-tuning subsets, so the values before fine-tuning differ slightly from Table 16 .
sents.zh: 表 17 报告了微调子集上的结果，因此微调前的数值与表 16 略有不同。

sents.en: For both explicit energy models, the prediction error drops by about two thirds, to 7.6 7.6 mm and 8.8 8.8 mm.
sents.zh: 对于两种显式能量模型，预测误差均下降了约三分之二，降至 7.6 毫米和 8.8 毫米。

sents.en: For ARAP, the kinetic energy ratio moves from 0.80 0.80 to 0.92 0.92 , so the LDM learns the softer material from the trajectories alone.
sents.zh: 对于 ARAP，动能比从 0.80 变为 0.92，因此 LDM 仅通过轨迹就学会了更柔软的材料特性。

sents.en: On the real point clouds, the error drops from 921 921 to 6.2 6.2 mm: the LDM learns from the tracked points that a resting object stays on the table and how the points move (Fig. 18 ).
sents.zh: 在真实点云上，误差从 921 毫米降至 6.2 毫米：LDM 从跟踪点中学到静止物体会留在桌上，以及这些点如何移动（图 18）。

paragraphs.en: In summary, the same PhysLDM, with the same code and losses, handles simulations with different energy models, real captured trajectories without an explicit energy model, and other data formats such as point clouds. Its ST-VAE transfers to all of them zero-shot, and its LDM adapts to them by fine-tuning. Visual results of PhysLDM on the real captured data are shown in Fig. 18 .
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，同一个 PhysLDM，使用相同的代码和损失函数，能够处理采用不同能量模型的模拟、没有显式能量模型的真实捕获轨迹，以及点云等其他数据格式。 其 ST-VAE 能够零样本迁移到所有这些数据，而 LDM 则通过微调来适应它们。 PhysLDM 在真实捕获数据上的可视化结果如图 18 所示。

sents.en: In summary, the same PhysLDM, with the same code and losses, handles simulations with different energy models, real captured trajectories without an explicit energy model, and other data formats such as point clouds.
sents.zh: 总而言之，同一个 PhysLDM，使用相同的代码和损失函数，能够处理采用不同能量模型的模拟、没有显式能量模型的真实捕获轨迹，以及点云等其他数据格式。

sents.en: Its ST-VAE transfers to all of them zero-shot, and its LDM adapts to them by fine-tuning.
sents.zh: 其 ST-VAE 能够零样本迁移到所有这些数据，而 LDM 则通过微调来适应它们。

sents.en: Visual results of PhysLDM on the real captured data are shown in Fig. 18 .
